after.zh:
刘易斯与克拉克考察队于1804年末来到已有曼丹和希达察贸易城镇的地区。刀河汇入口附近，季节性交换吸引来自密苏里河远近各处的人。考察队选择在附近越冬，依靠的是既有食物、关系与信息的汇集。

曼丹人告诉来访者，翻越落基山脉需要肖肖尼马匹。因此，招募夏博诺与萨卡加维亚，同通过原住民建议形成的计划相连。后续会面依靠传译链：请求可由英语转为法语、希达察语与肖肖尼语，答复再经同样的人传回。传译促成合作，也可能产生误解。

萨卡加维亚的食物与地标知识属于更广泛的学习、亲属联系及旅行经验。MHA叙述进一步说明，亲属用语不能直接当成现代谱系图来读。至1806年，美国勘察一直依赖那些土地正被描述和声称拥有的社群。向考察队分享知识，并不自动构成对帝国领土主张的同意。

items.rationale: Remove the empty-land straw-man contrast; the opening explicitly retains pre-existing Mandan and Hidatsa towns and exchange networks. Remove the reader’s chronological instruction; preserve Indigenous knowledge, translation uncertainty, source-specific kinship interpretation and the distinction between knowledge sharing and consent.

before.en:
Kinngait’s annual graphic collections linked Inuit artistic work to audiences far beyond southern Baffin Island. The studios began releasing annual catalogued collections in 1959. The cooperative provided an institutional setting in which drawings could become editions, while individual artists continued developing different visual languages. This was a new print programme, not the beginning of Inuit creativity.

A print involved more than an image’s design. In stonecut work, an original drawing was traced onto a prepared stone; the cutter removed areas not meant to print, then ink and hand pressure transferred the raised design to paper. Each impression required renewed inking. The drawing, cutting and printing were distinct stages, so crediting a design does not prove its creator personally performed every task. Lithography added another process in the early 1970 s.

Kenojuak Ashevak’s career developed within this environment. In 1978 the cooperative established Dorset Fine Arts in Toronto as its wholesale marketing division. Northern production and southern distribution had different roles. The 1959–1978 window follows an annual collection, changing workshop methods and a later marketing institution; it is neither the cooperative’s complete lifespan nor an end date for art-making. Public visibility depended on creative work and the practical institutions that connected makers with audiences.
before.zh:
金盖特年度版画集把因纽特艺术劳动连接到巴芬岛南部以外的观众。作坊自1959年起发行年度编目作品集。合作社提供将画稿转为版次的制度背景，个人艺术家则继续发展不同视觉语言。这是新的版画计划，不是因纽特创造力的开端。

版画制作不仅涉及图像设计。石刻凸版制作时，先将原画转描到备好的石面；刻版者移除不需印出的区域，再以墨和手压把凸起图像转到纸上。每张印本都需重新上墨。绘图、刻制与印刷是不同阶段，因此设计署名并不证明作者亲手完成所有工序。1970年代初引入的石版印刷，又增添了一种方法。

凯诺朱阿克·阿什瓦克的事业在此环境中发展。1978年，合作社在多伦多设立多塞特美术机构作为批发营销部门。北方制作与南方流通承担不同角色。1959—1978年追踪年度作品集、变化的作坊工艺及后来的营销机构，不是合作社的完整生卒，也不是艺术创作的结束。公共可见度依赖创作劳动，以及连接制作者和观众的实际机构。

Remove window/lifespan phrasing; retain continued artistic life and the separate credits for drawing, cutting and printing. Correct English decade spacing; the Chinese date was already correctly spaced.

before.en:
Cuba’s 1961 literacy campaign treated learning to read and write as a national mobilization. Its surviving documentation allows the campaign to be examined through the materials used in teaching and through the written traces left by learners. This approach connects a major political project with smaller encounters between people, texts and new skills.

The National Literacy Museum preserves manuals, primers, correspondence and other records. The teaching materials include the Cartilla Venceremos and Manual Alfabeticemos; letters addressed to Fidel Castro form another part of the collection. Such sources reveal how education was organized and how learning was presented within the revolutionary public sphere. They are also selected records shaped by the institutions that created and preserved them.

A campaign’s declared success and the experience of an individual learner are different historical questions. The archive provides routes for investigating both, but an inventory cannot by itself establish what every participant learned or believed. This entry therefore focuses on the campaign as an educational mobilization and a documented set of practices, without substituting a single literacy percentage for the diversity of lives involved.
before.zh:
古巴1961年的扫盲运动把学习读写作为全国性动员。留存文献使人能够通过教材及学习者留下的文字来考察运动，将宏大政治工程同人、文本和新技能之间的具体相遇连接起来。

国家扫盲博物馆保存教学手册、识字课本、书信及其他记录。材料包括《我们必胜》识字课本与扫盲教学手册；写给菲德尔·卡斯特罗的信件也是馆藏的一部分。这些来源显示教育如何被组织，以及学习如何在革命公共空间中被呈现。它们同时是经创造与保存机构选择的记录。

运动宣称的成果与个别学习者的经验，是不同的历史问题。档案为两者提供研究路径，但馆藏目录本身无法说明每一位参与者学会或相信了什么。因此，本条关注作为教育动员及具体实践的扫盲运动，不以单一识字率数字代替参与者多样的生命经历。

before.en:
The 1942 Kokoda campaign was fought over a mountain route between Papua’s north coast and the approaches to Port Moresby. Japanese and Australian forces struggled with terrain, illness and long supply lines. Papuan soldiers and carriers were indispensable: food, ammunition and wounded people moved along paths that vehicles could not use.

Later Australian remembrance often cast the carriers as uniformly willing and selfless helpers. Research preserved by the Australian War Memorial complicates that image with evidence of conscription, poor conditions, illness and unresolved questions of compensation and recognition. Papuan experiences included service and solidarity, but also coercion and loss. Putting labour beside military operations changes the campaign’s geography: villages, carrying routes and medical evacuation become part of the story, rather than a background to battles between foreign armies. It also prevents gratitude expressed later from substituting for an account of what wartime workers experienced.
before.zh:
1942年的科科达战役，围绕巴布亚北海岸通向莫尔兹比港外围的山地路线展开。日军与澳军都面临地形、疾病和漫长补给线的困难。巴布亚士兵与搬运工不可或缺：食物、弹药和伤员必须通过车辆无法行驶的小径运输。

澳大利亚后来的记忆常把搬运工描绘成一致自愿、无私的帮助者。澳大利亚战争纪念馆保存的研究，则以征发、恶劣条件、疾病，以及补偿和承认问题，使这一形象复杂化。巴布亚人的经验既有服务与团结，也有强制和损失。把劳动与军事行动并列，会改变战役的地理图景：村庄、运输路线和医疗撤离成为主体，不再只是外国军队作战的背景，也避免用后来的感谢取代对劳动者亲历的说明。

items.rationale: Remove reader coaching and a repeated commemorative warning; retain indispensable Papuan labour, conscription, poor conditions, illness, loss and unresolved compensation/recognition.

before.en:
The United States dropped an atomic bomb on Hiroshima on 6 August 1945. Heat, blast and radiation destroyed urban spaces and harmed people through different mechanisms. The city’s experience cannot be reduced to a military target symbol: households, workplaces, schools and medical institutions were part of the environment struck.

Objects, photographs and testimony preserved by the peace museum provide evidence about particular people and places. Each item has its own circumstances of survival and collection. Later remembrance became linked to debates about nuclear weapons, while survivors continued to live with consequences beyond the moment of the explosion. The precise attack date therefore anchors an event whose human and political history extends beyond a single day or the end of the war.
before.zh:
1945年8月6日，美国向广岛投下原子弹。热辐射、冲击波与核辐射以不同机制破坏城市并伤害人群。不能把城市经历缩减为军事目标符号：家庭、工作场所、学校及医疗机构，都处于遭受打击的环境之中。

和平纪念资料馆保存的器物、照片与证言，为具体人物和地点提供证据；每件材料都有自身留存和收集的背景。后来的纪念同核武器争论相连，幸存者也持续承受爆炸之后的后果。因此，精确的攻击日期只是一个锚点，其人类与政治史超出了单日乃至战争结束。

before.en: Japan’s postwar constitution was promulgated on 3 November 1946 and came into force on 3 May 1947. Its text located sovereignty with the people, defined the emperor’s symbolic position and set out fundamental rights and parliamentary institutions. Article 9 renounced war as a sovereign means of settling international disputes. The National Diet Library’s documents also show deliberation and the practical steps required to bring the new order into operation, including elections and related legislation. The change took place within the postwar occupation, so constitutional commencement should not be confused with the later end of occupation. The two dates mark distinct stages in a consequential institutional transition.
before.zh: 日本战后宪法于1946年11月3日公布，1947年5月3日生效。文本规定主权属于人民，界定天皇的象征地位，并确立基本权利与议会机构。第九条放弃以国家主权发动战争作为解决国际争端的手段。国立国会图书馆的文献还展示审议及新制度实际运作所需的步骤，包括选举和配套立法。这场变化发生于战后占领时期，因此宪法生效不能与后来占领结束混淆。两个日期标示这一重大制度转型的不同阶段。

The constitution came into force during the postwar occupation, which ended later.

items.rationale: Replace the confusion warning and generic conclusion with direct chronology; retain separate promulgation and effectiveness dates and all constitutional provisions.

before.en: Years of organizing by Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander activists and their allies helped produce overwhelming support for constitutional change. The referendum removed discriminatory provisions concerning population counts and the Commonwealth’s power to make laws for Aboriginal people. Campaigners treated the vote as a demand for practical action against inequality, not an endpoint. It did not first grant citizenship or voting rights, which had separate histories. Understanding those distinctions makes the achievement clearer: sustained grassroots work altered the constitutional framework, while the struggle over how government should use its powers continued after the ballots were counted.
before.zh: 原住民、托雷斯海峡岛民活动者及盟友多年组织宣传，最终赢得压倒性修宪支持。公投删除人口统计及联邦为原住民立法权方面的歧视性条款。参与者把投票视为要求实际改善不平等，而不是斗争终点。公投并非首次授予公民身份或投票权，两者另有历史。其具体成就在于基层运动改变宪制框架，政府应如何行使权力的争论则继续存在。

before.en:
Theformation of Malaysia in 1963 brought Malaya, Sabah, Sarawak and Singapore into a federation. The arrangement was contested within the region, and Indonesia’s Konfrontasi involved conflict across Borneo and the Malay Peninsula. Membership and political relationships were not settled permanently at the moment the federation was proclaimed.

Singapore left in 1965, while Konfrontasi continued until 1966. These events should therefore be distinguished from Malaya’s 1957 independence and from one another. A museum account centered on Commonwealth military involvement illuminates part of the conflict but cannot represent every Bornean community’s views. The entry connects existing constitutional milestones with their contested regional setting, showing that modern state formation combined negotiations, opposition and military force rather than a sequence of universally agreed administrative changes.
before.zh:
1963年马来西亚成立，将马来亚、沙巴、砂拉越及新加坡纳入联邦。区域内对此安排存在争议，印度尼西亚“对抗”行动在婆罗洲与马来半岛引发冲突。联邦宣布之时，并未永久确定成员和政治关系。

新加坡于1965年退出，“对抗”则延续至1966年。这些事件须同马来亚1957年独立及彼此之间区别。以英联邦军事参与为中心的博物馆介绍，只照亮冲突的一部分，不能代表每个婆罗洲社区的观点。本条把已有宪制节点连接到有争议的区域环境，显示现代建国同时涉及协商、反对和武力，而非人人同意的行政交接。

before.en: The Province of Canada, New Brunswick and Nova Scotia joined in a federal union under British legislation. Dividing the Province of Canada into Ontario and Quebec gave the new federation four provinces, not the full territory shown on a modern Canadian map. Other provinces and territories entered through later processes with distinct circumstances. Confederation also did not immediately create complete independence from Britain; external autonomy and constitutional change developed over generations. The event is best understood as one institutional beginning within a longer history of expansion, negotiation and conflict over whose authority would govern northern North America.
before.zh: 加拿大省、新不伦瑞克和新斯科舍依据英国法律组成联邦；加拿大省分为安大略与魁北克，因此最初只有四省，并非今日地图的全部疆域。其他省区经各自不同过程加入。联邦成立也未立即实现对英国的完全独立，外交自主与宪制变化历时多代。1867年是在更长的扩张、谈判与北美北部统治权冲突中，一个重要的制度起点。

after.en: In 1867, the Province of Canada, New Brunswick and Nova Scotia joined in a federation under British legislation. Dividing the Province of Canada into Ontario and Quebec created the initial four provinces. Later accessions expanded the federation through separate negotiations and conflicts over land and authority. External autonomy and constitutional independence from Britain developed over subsequent generations.
after.zh: 1867年，加拿大省、新不伦瑞克与新斯科舍依据英国法律组成联邦。加拿大省分为安大略和魁北克，形成最初四省。此后的加入过程扩大了联邦，也伴随有关土地与权威的谈判和冲突。外交自主及对英国的宪制独立，则在此后数代中逐步发展。

before.en:
John Alexander Macdonald’s life connected a Kingston legal practice to the construction of a federal state. Born in Glasgow in 1815, he came to Upper Canada with his parents as a child. Legal training, business relationships and local politics gave him connections before his 1844 election to the Province of Canada’s assembly. His career depended on coalition, including cooperation with George-Étienne Cartier and French Canadian Conservatives, rather than the work of one founder acting alone.

He became the new Dominion’s first prime minister in 1867. His government expanded federal territory and institutions while disputes over land and authority continued. The Pacific Scandal exposed campaign financing linked to a railway contract and forced his resignation in 1873. After years in opposition, he returned to office in 1878 with a protectionist programme. Higher tariffs followed in 1879; railway financing and western settlement formed connected aspects of his administration’s plans.

The same state-building imposed exclusion and coercion. As superintendent general of Indian Affairs from 1878 to 1887, Macdonald bore direct responsibility for policy toward First Nations. His government expanded federally supported residential schooling in 1883, an assimilationist programme that separated children from communities. In the western interior, officials used control over food supplies to force people onto reserves amid the destruction of bison-based livelihoods. Chinese workers’ contribution to the railway was followed by discriminatory voting and immigration measures, including the 1885 head-tax law.

Macdonald died in Ottawa in 1891. His political skill and institution-building belong in the same history as these policies and their unequal consequences. His biography does not turn Confederation into the origin of all peoples’ histories or attribute later governments’ actions indiscriminately to his years in power.
before.zh:
约翰·亚历山大·麦克唐纳的一生，把金斯顿律师事务与联邦国家建构连接起来。他1815年出生于格拉斯哥，幼年随父母来到上加拿大。法律训练、商业关系与地方政治为他建立网络，1844年当选加拿大省议会议员。其事业依靠联盟，包括同乔治—艾蒂安·卡蒂埃及法裔加拿大保守派合作，而非一位建国者独自行动。

1867年，他成为新自治领首任总理。政府扩展联邦领土和机构，土地与权威争议却持续存在。太平洋丑闻揭露与铁路合同相连的竞选筹款，迫使他1873年辞职。在野数年后，1878年以保护主义纲领重新执政。1879年提高关税；铁路融资和西部定居也是相关施政计划。

同一国家建构过程施加了排斥与强制。麦克唐纳1878至1887年兼任印第安事务总监，对第一民族政策负有直接责任。其政府1883年扩展联邦支持的寄宿学校，以同化为目标使儿童与社群分离。在野牛生计遭破坏的背景下，西部内陆官员通过控制食物供应，迫使人们进入保留地。华工建设铁路的贡献，也伴随着歧视性的投票和移民措施，包括1885年的人头税法。

1891年，他在渥太华去世。政治技巧及机构建设必须与这些政策及其不平等后果一同理解。本传不把联邦成立当作所有民族历史的起点，也不把后来政府的行为不加区别地归于其执政年代。

after.en:
John Alexander Macdonald was born in Glasgow in 1815 and came to Upper Canada with his family as a child. A Kingston lawyer, he entered the Province of Canada’s assembly in 1844. His political strength rested on coalition-building, including cooperation with George-Étienne Cartier and French Canadian Conservatives.

He became the new Dominion’s first prime minister in 1867. His government expanded federal territory and institutions amid disputes over land and authority. The Pacific Scandal exposed campaign financing linked to a railway contract and forced his resignation in 1873. He returned to office in 1878 with a protectionist programme; higher tariffs followed in 1879, alongside railway financing and western settlement plans.

State-building also imposed exclusion and coercion. Macdonald served as superintendent general of Indian Affairs from 1878 to 1887. His government expanded federally supported residential schooling in 1883, separating children from their communities through an assimilationist programme. As bison-based livelihoods collapsed, officials used control over food to force people onto reserves. Chinese workers’ contribution to the railway was followed by discriminatory voting and immigration measures, including the 1885 head-tax law. Macdonald died in Ottawa in 1891.
after.zh:
约翰·亚历山大·麦克唐纳1815年出生于格拉斯哥，幼年随家人来到上加拿大。他在金斯顿从事律师工作，1844年进入加拿大省议会。其政治力量建立在联盟之上，包括与乔治—艾蒂安·卡蒂埃及法裔加拿大保守派的合作。

1867年，他成为新自治领首任总理。政府在土地与权威争议中扩展联邦领土和机构。涉及铁路合同与竞选筹款的太平洋丑闻迫使他于1873年辞职。他1878年以保护主义纲领重新执政，1879年提高关税，并推行铁路融资与西部定居计划。

国家建构也施加了排斥和强制。麦克唐纳1878至1887年兼任印第安事务总监。其政府1883年扩展联邦支持的寄宿学校，以同化为目标使儿童与社群分离。野牛生计崩溃之际，官员通过控制食物供应迫使人们进入保留地。华工建设铁路后面临歧视性的投票和移民措施，包括1885年人头税法。麦克唐纳于1891年在渥太华去世。

before.en:
The Western Jin belongs on the timeline before the end of the Three Kingdoms, not only after it. Its ruling house replaced Wei while Wu still survived in the south. A brief reunification therefore sits within a longer dynastic span, followed by renewed political fragmentation. Reading overlapping bars makes that distinction visible.

Material culture also complicates a history told only through conquests. A Western Jin funerary urn in the Metropolitan Museum combines a model palace, auspicious animals and Buddhist figures. The museum interprets this as evidence of Buddhism entering existing beliefs about the afterlife. The object cannot establish an imperial frontier, but it opens another question: what changed in religious life while political institutions were being remade?
before.zh:
西晋并非到三国结束后才出现：司马氏取代魏时，南方的吴仍然存在。因此，短暂统一只是较长王朝时段中的一个阶段，随后又出现政治分裂。把同时期政权并排显示，能避免把“建立王朝”和“完成统一”混为一谈。

实物也使这段历史不止于征服。大都会博物馆的一件西晋魂瓶把楼阁、瑞兽与佛像组合在一起，馆方将其解释为佛教逐渐进入本土来世信仰的证据。器物不能证明帝国边界，却能帮助理解：政治制度变化之际，宗教生活也在改变。

after.en:
The Western Jin replaced Wei in 265 while Wu still ruled in the south. Reunification in 280 was one phase of the dynasty’s history, followed by renewed political fragmentation.

A Western Jin funerary urn at the Metropolitan Museum (1992.165.21) raises a model palace above animals and rows of Buddhist figures. Its olive-green glaze covers a crowded, vertical miniature world. The museum interprets this combination as Buddhism entering existing beliefs about the afterlife.
after.zh:
西晋于265年取代魏，南方的吴仍然存在。280年的统一只是王朝历史中的一个阶段，随后又出现政治分裂。

大都会博物馆的一件西晋魂瓶（1992.165.21）在动物与成排佛像上方筑起楼阁模型。橄榄绿釉覆盖着密集向上延伸的微型世界。馆方将这种组合解释为佛教进入既有来世信仰的表现。

before.en:
The Eastern Jin maintained an imperial court in the lower Yangzi while northern China contained competing states. It should appear alongside those northern histories rather than filling a single China-wide succession slot. Jiankang anchors the entry geographically; its location does not imply that the court governed the whole area shown by any broad cultural label.

The southern court was also part of the landscape in which calligraphy, painting and ceramic traditions developed. A fourth-century green-glazed jar catalogued by the Metropolitan Museum provides one dated material example. Political division did not stop cultural production or exchange. Compare this entry with Northern Wei and the later Liu Song to follow both overlapping institutions and changes at the southern court.
before.zh:
东晋以长江下游为朝廷中心，而北方有多个政权并存。它应当与北方历史并排呈现，而非占据一个代表全中国的单线朝代位置。建康只是本条目的地理锚点，不意味着朝廷统治了所有被文化标签涵盖的地区。

南方也是书法、绘画与陶瓷传统发展的环境。大都会博物馆收藏的一件四世纪青釉四系罐，提供了有年代范围的实物例证。政治分裂并没有使文化生产与交流停止。可把东晋与北魏、后来的刘宋比较，观察同时存在的制度与南方朝廷的更替。

after.en:
The Eastern Jin maintained its court at Jiankang from 317 to 420 while competing states ruled in northern China. Liu Song later succeeded it at the southern capital.

A fourth-century jar at the Metropolitan Museum (1977.449.8) gives the period’s ceramics a tangible scale: it stands just 7.3 centimetres high, with four lugs around its shoulder. The catalogue identifies Yue-type stoneware with green glaze.
after.zh:
东晋于317至420年以建康为朝廷中心，北方则有多个政权并存。此后刘宋在南方都城继承东晋。

大都会博物馆的一件四世纪罐（1977.449.8），为此期陶瓷提供可感的尺度：高仅7.3厘米，肩部有四系。馆方将其定为越窑式青釉炻器。

before.en:
Liu Song was the southern dynasty that followed Eastern Jin in 420. Its name needs an explicit qualifier: it is separated by centuries from the Northern and Southern Song of the tenth to thirteenth centuries. The two uses of “Song” must not merge in search, on the map or in a dynasty sequence.

Northern Wei existed at the same time in the north. Showing both spans is more informative than presenting a single ruler for all China. The period is part of a wider history of courts based at Jiankang and of cultural connections across political divisions. Follow the southern sequence from Eastern Jin to Liu Song, Southern Qi, Liang and Chen, then compare their dates with northern changes.
before.zh:
刘宋于420年继承东晋，是南方王朝。“宋”必须加以区分：它与十至十三世纪的北宋、南宋相隔数百年，搜索、地图与朝代序列都不应把两者混合。

北方的北魏与之同时存在。并排显示两个政权，比为全中国安排一个统治者更能解释当时局势。刘宋也属于以建康为中心的南方朝廷历史，以及跨越政治分界的文化联系史。可沿东晋、刘宋、南齐、梁、陈的次序阅读，再与北方变化比较。

after.en:
In 420, Liu Yu took the imperial title and replaced Eastern Jin with Song, ruling from Jiankang. His accession decrees ordered remission of overdue taxes and debts; subsequent orders addressed official purchasing and market taxes. The surviving portrait presents him as a dynastic founder through Qing-era eyes.

Liu Song lasted until 479, alongside Northern Wei in the north, and was followed by Southern Qi. It is distinct from the Song founded in 960.
after.zh:
420年，刘裕即皇帝位，建立宋朝，取代东晋，以建康为都。即位诏令要求免除积欠租税与债务，随后又下令整顿官府采购、减轻市税。存世画像以清代的视角呈现这位开国君主。

刘宋与北魏并立，延续至479年，之后由南齐继承；它与960年建立的宋朝不同。

items.rationale: Add the actual founder and his documented accession orders, distinguish decrees from implementation, and retain the two Song dynasties and northern/southern chronology.

before.en:
Southern Qi followed Liu Song at Jiankang and preceded Liang. Its short bar belongs within a longer southern sequence, while Northern Wei continued in the north. This makes it possible to ask what a dynastic replacement changes: a ruling house and court institutions can change without every neighboring society starting over.

“Qi” also needs context. Southern Qi is distinct from the Warring States kingdom of Qi and from the later Northern Qi. The atlas keeps separate dates and places for those names. Read the cited regional chronology alongside individual events to distinguish an era label, an imperial house and the territory that a particular map stage actually depicts.
before.zh:
南齐在建康继承刘宋，之后又由梁取代。它的短时段属于更长的南方朝廷序列，而北魏仍在北方延续。这能帮助提出一个具体问题：王朝更替改变了统治家族与朝廷制度，却并不意味着周边社会同时重新开始。

“齐”也必须结合时空辨认。南齐既不是战国齐国，也不是后来的北齐。本图集以不同年代与地点区分这些名称。把区域年表与具体事件结合阅读，可以避免混淆时代标签、皇室和某个地图阶段实际呈现的辖境。

after.en:
Southern Qi ruled at Jiankang from 479 to 502, following Liu Song and preceding Liang. Northern Wei continued in the north. A change of ruling house at the southern court took place within continuing regional institutions and social connections.

Southern Qi is distinct from both the Warring States kingdom of Qi and the later Northern Qi.
after.zh:
南齐于479至502年以建康为都，上承刘宋，下启梁，北方的北魏仍然延续。南方朝廷更换统治家族之时，区域制度与社会联系也在继续。

南齐不同于战国齐国，也不同于后来的北齐。

before.en:
The Liang dynasty continued the southern court sequence at Jiankang. Emperor Wu’s court supported scholarship, artists and Buddhist activity. The museum chronology records his Buddhist commitments and a mission to India for texts, placing the court within networks wider than the area it governed.

At the same time, northern politics changed from Northern Wei into competing eastern and western successor regimes. Liang therefore cannot stand for a single government across China. Compare the court’s religious and literary activity with northern Buddhist landscapes rather than treating the south as disconnected. The end of the dynasty also precedes the conquest of Chen: the beginning of Sui in 581 and southern reunification in 589 are separate milestones.
before.zh:
梁延续以建康为中心的南方朝廷序列。梁武帝朝廷支持学术、艺术与佛教活动；博物馆年表还记载其佛教信仰以及赴印度求取经籍的活动，使南方朝廷置于超越辖境的联系网络中。

与此同时，北方从北魏转入东西两个继承体系，梁不能代表全中国的统一政府。可以把南方朝廷的宗教、文学活动与北方佛教景观并读，而非把南方视为隔绝世界。梁结束后还有陈；581年隋建立与589年征服陈，也是不同的历史节点。

after.en:
Liang ruled from Jiankang between 502 and 557. Emperor Wu’s court supported scholarship, artists and Buddhist activity, including a mission to India for texts. These connections extended beyond the territory the court governed.

In the north, Northern Wei divided into eastern and western successor regimes. Buddhist landscapes and literary activity connected this politically divided world. Chen succeeded Liang in the south and survived the founding of Sui in 581 until its conquest in 589.
after.zh:
梁于502至557年以建康为都。梁武帝朝廷支持学术、艺术与佛教活动，包括赴印度求取经籍的使行。这些联系超出了朝廷管辖的地域。

北方的北魏分裂为东西两个继承政权。佛教景观与文学活动连接着政治分立的世界。陈在南方继承梁，经历581年隋的建立，直至589年被征服。

items.rationale: Replace interface instructions and defensive exposition with concise historical narrative; preserve material chronology distinctions.

before.en:
Chen was the last of the southern dynasties before Sui reunification. It followed Liang and coexisted with the northern transition from Northern Zhou to Sui. A timeline that replaces all southern history with “Sui” from 581 hides those final years of political separation. Chen’s bar continues until 589, the date the cited chronology uses for Sui unification.

This overlap is a useful way to read any imperial history: distinguish a dynasty’s establishment from its expansion and from the fall of another court. The map should likewise identify the stage it depicts. Jiankang locates the southern court; it does not imply a fixed frontier throughout the dynasty’s existence.
before.zh:
陈是隋统一之前最后一个南方王朝。它继承梁，并经历北方从北周到隋的更替。如果时间线从581年起就以“隋”覆盖整个中国，便会抹去南北仍然并立的最后数年。陈应延续显示到589年，即引用年表所列隋统一的年份。

这组重叠也提供通用的读史方法：区分王朝建立、疆域扩展与另一朝廷覆亡。地图同样需要交代呈现的是哪个阶段。建康点位用于定位南方朝廷，不表示整个王朝时期都有不变边界。

after.en: Chen began in 557 at Jiankang, succeeding Liang as the last southern dynasty before Sui reunification. In the north, Sui replaced Northern Zhou in 581. Chen continued for another eight years, until the Sui conquest of 589 ended the separation of the northern and southern courts.
after.zh: 陈于557年在建康继承梁，是隋统一之前最后一个南方王朝。北方的隋于581年取代北周，陈此后仍延续八年，直至589年隋的征服结束南北朝廷的并立。

items.rationale: Replace interface instructions and defensive exposition with concise historical narrative; preserve material chronology distinctions.

before.en:
Northern Wei emerged among the competing regimes of northern China and belongs alongside Eastern Jin and the southern dynasties. Its Tuoba Xianbei rulers made Buddhism an important part of the political and artistic landscape. At Yungang near Datong, large cave sanctuaries and sculptural programs make state-supported religious work visible in stone.

The kingdom’s history should not be compressed into a static ethnic label. The source literature describes interaction across northern and southern societies and with Central Asian Buddhist traditions. Nor is a religious site an outline of governmental reach. The end of Northern Wei led into Eastern and Western Wei rather than an immediate reunification of all China; the paired northern successions remain essential context for the Sui.
before.zh:
北魏兴起于北方多个政权竞争的环境中，与东晋及南朝同时存在。拓跋鲜卑统治者使佛教成为政治和艺术景观的重要部分。大同附近的云冈石窟，以洞窟与造像留下朝廷支持宗教建设的实物证据。

这段历史不能压缩为不变的族群标签。研究资料也讨论南北社会以及中亚佛教传统之间的互动。宗教遗址更不等于行政势力范围。北魏之后出现东魏与西魏，并非立刻实现全中国统一；这些并立和继承关系，是理解隋朝之前局势的必要背景。

after.en:
Northern Wei emerged under the Tuoba Xianbei in 386 and ruled in the north alongside successive southern courts. Its Buddhist patronage helped shape major religious landscapes, including the Yungang caves near its earlier capital at Pingcheng.

Court institutions and artistic practices developed through contacts across northern China, the south and Central Asia. The dynasty divided into Eastern and Western Wei in 534–535, beginning another phase of political competition before Sui reunification.
after.zh:
拓跋鲜卑于386年建立北魏，在北方统治，与南方历代朝廷并立。北魏对佛教的支持塑造了重要宗教景观，包括早期都城平城附近的云冈石窟。

朝廷制度与艺术实践在中国北方、南方及中亚之间的交往中发展。534至535年，北魏分为东魏与西魏，开启隋统一之前又一阶段的政治竞争。

items.rationale: Replace interface instructions and defensive exposition with concise historical narrative; preserve material chronology distinctions.

before.en:
Faith Bandler connected a family history of Pacific labour coercion with campaigns against racial discrimination in Australia. Her father had been taken from Vanuatu to Queensland as a child. During the Second World War, Bandler worked in the Women’s Land Army; later she brought public speaking and organizational work to movements supporting Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander rights.

Campaigning for the 1967 referendum involved meetings, fundraising, coordination and persuading voters, not only the final day of voting. Bandler helped make constitutional questions part of a wider public conversation about exclusion. The referendum changed Commonwealth legislative power concerning Aboriginal people and removed their exclusion from the constitutional population reckoning; it did not itself grant citizenship or the vote. Reading her biography beside plantation labour and the referendum shows how personal memory, alliance and sustained collective effort can change institutions without reducing reform to a single leader or a single ballot.
before.zh:
费思·班德勒把家族经历的太平洋劳工强制，与澳大利亚反种族歧视运动相连。她父亲童年时被从瓦努阿图带至昆士兰。第二次世界大战期间，她在妇女陆军劳动队工作；后来把演讲与组织能力用于支持澳大利亚原住民及托雷斯海峡岛民权利的运动。

1967年公投运动包含会议、筹款、协调与说服选民，而不只是投票当天。班德勒使宪法问题进入关于排斥的公共讨论。公投改变联邦针对原住民的立法权限，并取消宪法人口计算中的排除条款；它本身并未授予公民身份或投票权。与种植园劳工和公投并读，可见个人记忆、联盟与持久集体努力如何改变制度，而不把改革压缩成单一领袖或一次投票。

after.en:
Faith Bandler connected a family history of Pacific labour coercion with campaigns against racial discrimination in Australia. Her father had been taken from Vanuatu to Queensland as a child. She served in the Women’s Land Army during the Second World War, then became an organizer and speaker for Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander rights.

Years of meetings, fundraising and public persuasion helped build support for the 1967 referendum. It changed Commonwealth legislative power concerning Aboriginal people and removed their exclusion from constitutional population reckoning. It did not itself grant citizenship or the vote.
after.zh:
费思·班德勒把家族经历的太平洋劳工强制，与澳大利亚反种族歧视运动相连。她父亲童年时被从瓦努阿图带到昆士兰。二战期间，她在妇女陆军劳动队工作，后来通过组织与演讲支持澳大利亚原住民及托雷斯海峡岛民权利。

多年的会议、筹款与公众说服，为1967年公投争取支持。公投改变联邦针对原住民的立法权限，并取消宪法人口计算中的排除条款；它本身并未授予公民身份或投票权。

before.en:
The Satavahanas were one of several powers that emerged after Mauryan rule fragmented. Their Deccan kingdom belonged to a political landscape shared with Shaka rulers and other regional dynasties. Its history helps replace the idea that the whole subcontinent passed from one empire to another.

Buddhist monuments and inscriptions preserve relationships among rulers, donors and religious communities. These sources do not describe a single state with unchanged boundaries. The northern Kushans and western Shaka rulers offer useful contemporary comparisons: connected trade and cultural worlds could coexist with political competition.
before.zh:
孔雀王朝统治瓦解之后，百乘王朝成为兴起的区域政权之一。其德干王国与塞种统治者及其他王朝共享一个多中心的政治世界。它的历史帮助我们跳出整个次大陆由一个帝国接替另一个帝国的想象。

佛教建筑和铭文留下王室、捐献者与宗教群体之间关系的线索。这些材料并不表示国家疆界始终不变。北方贵霜与西部塞种政权是可供同时比较的对象：贸易和文化联系能够与政治竞争并存。

after.en:

A copper-nickel portrait medallion, dated to about the first century CE and attributed to the Satavahana period, makes these wider connections tangible. The Met identifies it as probably from Maharashtra and possibly a cloak clasp. Its unnamed male bust has parallels in Parthian royal portraiture, suggesting how West Asian luxury objects could inspire local makers.

before.en:
The Ghaznavid dynasty grew from the power of Turkic military commanders on the Samanid frontier. From Ghazni its rulers built a kingdom linking eastern Iranian lands with Afghanistan and northwestern South Asia. Its territories changed through campaigns, competition and the rise of neighboring powers.

Persian court culture and literary patronage accompanied military expansion. The Seljuq victory at Dandanakan in 1040 removed much of the western realm; later rulers survived farther east, ultimately in the Punjab. The Ghurid capture of Lahore in 1186 ended the remaining dynasty. A single broad empire outline would hide this shifting political geography.
before.zh:
伽色尼王朝兴起于萨曼边疆突厥军事统领的权力。统治者以伽色尼为基地，建立连接伊朗东部、阿富汗和南亚西北部的王国。领地随战争、竞争与邻国兴起而变化。

军事扩张伴随波斯宫廷文化和文学资助。1040年塞尔柱在丹丹干获胜，使其失去西部大部分领土；后继统治者在更东部、最终在旁遮普继续统治。1186年古尔攻占拉合尔，终结了余下王朝。用一张固定帝国轮廓无法表现这种变化。

The Ghaznavid dynasty grew from the power of Turkic military commanders on the Samanid frontier. From Ghazni its rulers built a kingdom linking eastern Iranian lands with Afghanistan and northwestern South Asia. Its territories changed through campaigns, competition and the rise of neighboring powers.

Persian court culture and literary patronage accompanied military expansion. The Seljuq victory at Dandanakan in 1040 removed much of the western realm; later rulers survived farther east, ultimately in the Punjab. The Ghurid capture of Lahore in 1186 ended the remaining dynasty.

Craft objects preserve another kind of written culture. An eleventh-century high-tin bronze bowl, attributed to Afghanistan and probably Ghazni, carries Arabic maxims, good wishes and the name of its maker, Abu Nasr al-Naqqash. Its bright, resonant metal offered an alternative to silver. This surviving work adds an individual artisan to a history often told through military commanders and court patrons.

before.en:
The Napatan phase of Kush places a Nubian political center within a connected Nile world. Kushite kings consolidated power in Nubia and, during the eighth and seventh centuries BCE, also ruled Egypt. Their history cannot be reduced to a one-way movement of Egyptian civilization southward: Nubian rulers selected, adapted and used religious and royal forms to assert their own authority.

Napata’s association with Jebel Barkal made sacred landscape part of government. Nile travel, access to resources and relationships with neighboring communities also shaped power. The later movement of royal burial and political emphasis toward Meroë was a transformation within Kushite history, not the sudden appearance of an unrelated people. Reading this overview between Kerma and Meroë fills a political sequence while keeping distinct the kingdom’s lifespan, archaeological period labels and the changing locations of royal activity.
before.zh:
库施的纳帕塔阶段把一个努比亚政治中心置于相连的尼罗河世界。库施诸王在努比亚巩固权力，并于公元前八至七世纪统治埃及。其历史不能简化为埃及文明单向向南传播：努比亚统治者选择、调整并运用宗教和王室形式，建立自身权威。

纳帕塔与杰贝勒巴尔卡尔山的联系，使神圣景观成为治理的一部分。尼罗河交通、资源获取及邻近社区关系同样塑造权力。后来王室葬地与政治重心转向麦罗埃，是库施内部的转变，而非无关人群突然出现。将本条放在凯尔迈与麦罗埃之间，能补足政治序列，同时区分王国存续、考古分期与王室活动地点的变化。

after.en:

The later movement of royal burial and political emphasis toward Meroë was a transformation within Kushite history, not the sudden appearance of an unrelated people.

A small glazed-steatite statuette gives this royal history a material form. The Met identifies its surviving kneeling figure as King Shabaqo and dates it to about 705–690 BCE, within the Kushite Twenty-fifth Dynasty. Only part of the figure survives, bringing royal representation into view without supplying a complete likeness.

before.en:
Mixtec history was organized around several interacting kingdoms, with rulers forming alliances through marriage, ritual and warfare. Painted screenfold books recorded genealogies, places and political acts. They preserve a way of making historical authority visible that differs from an alphabetical chronicle.

Archaeologists combine these manuscripts with settlement surveys to investigate the relationships among named places and ruling families. The surviving books often present elite perspectives, not a complete census of ordinary lives. The timeline therefore labels a sequence of kingdoms rather than inventing one unified Mixtec empire.
before.zh:
米斯特克历史围绕多个互相联系的王国展开，统治者通过婚姻、仪式与战争结成关系。彩绘折叠书记录谱系、地点和政治行为，保存一种不同于字母文字编年史的历史权威表达方式。

考古学家把这些写本与聚落调查结合，研究地名和统治家族之间的关系。现存书籍往往表达精英视角，并非普通生活的完整清单。因此时间线标记的是诸王国序列，而不是虚构一个统一米斯特克帝国。

after.en:

Painted screenfold books recorded genealogies, places and political acts. They preserve a way of making historical authority visible that differs from an alphabetical chronicle.

Archaeologists combine these manuscripts with settlement surveys to investigate the relationships among named places and ruling families. The surviving books often present elite perspectives, not a complete census of ordinary lives.

Religious imagery also took shape in carved vessels. The Met attributes a tenth–thirteenth-century stone container representing Ehecatl, the wind deity, to Mixtec (Ñuu Savi) artists. This object adds a different material and scale to the painted books: it records sculptural work and a named divine figure, rather than a genealogy or a particular royal alliance.

before.en: Srivijaya developed as a major Buddhist and maritime power associated with Sumatra and connections across the seas of Southeast Asia. Palembang and Jambi were important centres in its changing history. Authority depended on relationships among ports, rulers and routes rather than on a single continuously controlled landmass. Religious networks and commercial exchange connected the region with wider Asian worlds. By the later thirteenth century, competing powers were reshaping these relationships. The story is partly reconstructed from inscriptions and outside accounts, so sweeping claims about fixed imperial borders should be treated more cautiously than evidence for particular places and contacts.
before.zh: 室利佛逝成为以苏门答腊为重要基地的佛教与海上强权，巨港和占碑在不同时期发挥关键作用。其权力依赖港口、统治者与航路之间的关系，并非始终控制一整片连续陆地。宗教网络和商业交流把东南亚连接到更广的亚洲。至十三世纪后期，竞争势力重塑这些联系。历史部分依赖铭文与外来记载重建，因此固定帝国疆界的宏大主张，需要比具体地点和交往证据更谨慎地处理。

after.en:
Srivijaya developed as a major Buddhist and maritime power associated with Sumatra and connections across the seas of Southeast Asia. Palembang and Jambi were important centres in its changing history. Authority depended on relationships among ports, rulers and routes rather than on a single continuously controlled landmass. Religious networks and commercial exchange connected the region with wider Asian worlds. By the later thirteenth century, competing powers were reshaping these relationships. Inscriptions and outside accounts preserve evidence of particular places and contacts.

An eighth–ninth-century bronze figure from Sumatra adds a small-scale religious object to this maritime history. Catalogued as Srivijaya period, it represents a standing deity, possibly Vishnu. The tentative identification matters: the object offers evidence of religious imagery in the region without identifying a particular patron, temple or state-sponsored cult.

before.en:
The Qutb Shahi court belonged to the political landscape of the Deccan successor states. Golconda’s connections with diamond and textile commerce drew the region into markets reaching beyond South Asia. Courtly wealth depended on extraction, manufacture and the movement of goods, making the workers and intermediaries behind valuable objects part of political history.

The Mughal conquest in 1687 changed the sovereign order without ending regional trade or the life of Hyderabad. Dates associated with emerging autonomy, formal dynastic rule and capital construction need not coincide. This entry uses a conventional dynastic frame and a representative court region. It should be read with Bijapur and the textile entry to connect state formation with production and migration, without inferring that commercial influence was identical to directly administered territory.
before.zh:
库特布·沙希宫廷属于德干继承国家的政治格局。戈尔康达同钻石、纺织品贸易的联系，把区域接入超出南亚的市场。宫廷财富依赖开采、制造与运输，珍贵器物背后的劳动者和中间环节也因此属于政治史。

1687年的莫卧儿征服改变主权秩序，却没有终止区域贸易或海得拉巴的生活。逐渐取得自主、正式王朝统治和都城营建的日期不必相同。本条采用惯常王朝框架与代表性宫廷区域。与比贾布尔、织品条目并读，可把国家形成与生产、迁移相连，而不把商业影响当成直接管理的领土。

after.en:

Golconda’s connections with diamond and textile commerce drew the region into markets reaching beyond South Asia. Courtly wealth depended on extraction, manufacture and the movement of goods, making the workers and intermediaries behind valuable objects part of political history.

The Mughal conquest in 1687 changed the sovereign order without ending regional trade or the life of Hyderabad.

A pair of gilded copper lotus finials, attributed to Golconda and dated about 1650–1680, brings courtly metalwork into view. The Met explains that finials of this type decorated palanquins used by elite men and women in processions. Cast, pierced and chased flowers made craftsmanship visible to the crowd even when the passenger remained concealed.

before.en:
Jain traditions understand liberation through the teachings of the tirthankaras, with Mahavira remembered as the most recent of twenty-four teachers. Renunciation, disciplined conduct and care toward living beings shaped ideals for ascetic life, while lay followers supported religious communities. Images of seated or standing liberated teachers made those ideals visible without presenting the figures as ordinary royal portraits.

This long focus window connects religious ideas with institutions and artistic practice rather than treating Jain history as one person’s biography. Shared visual forms with other South Asian traditions did not make their teachings interchangeable. Patronage, devotion and demanding ascetic ideals could coexist, and their relationships changed across regions. The date range is a reading framework; it does not mark the beginning or end of a faith that continues beyond it.
before.zh:
耆那教传统通过渡津者的教导理解解脱，把大雄视为二十四位导师中最近的一位。出离、约束行为与爱护生命塑造苦行理想，在家信众则支持宗教共同体。坐姿或立姿的解脱导师形象使理想可见，却不是普通的王室肖像。

较长的关注时段连接思想、机构与艺术实践，而非把宗教史缩为一人的传记。与其他南亚传统共享某些视觉形式，不表示教义可以互换。资助、虔敬和严格苦行能够并存，其关系也因地区而变化。这里的年代只是阅读框架，不标志延续至今的信仰的起讫。

before.en:
Textiles from Myanmar connect cultivation, dyeing, weaving and exchange with the social meanings of clothing. Museum scientific work can identify materials and techniques that written political histories often leave unrecorded. Objects associated with Karen communities also challenge an account in which the whole region possesses one undifferentiated culture.

A collected textile has more than one history: production and use, transfer to a collection, and later scientific interpretation. The survival of an object does not establish the identity of every maker or every person who wore a similar pattern. Colonial-era collecting shaped what museums can now study and how it was classified. Following those layers brings ordinary work into the atlas while treating scientific findings as evidence about particular materials, not permission to assign a fixed ethnic identity to everyone in a mapped area.
before.zh:
缅甸纺织品把种植、染色、织造与交换，同衣着的社会意义连接。博物馆科学研究能够识别政治文字史常忽略的材料和技法。同克伦群体相关的器物，也反驳了整个区域拥有一种无差别文化的叙述。

一件入藏纺织品包含多重历史：制作与使用、转入收藏，以及后来的科学解释。器物留存不能确定每位制作者身份，也不能代表所有穿相近纹样的人。殖民时期收藏影响今日可研究内容及其分类。追踪这些层次，可以使普通劳动进入地图，同时把科学结果限定于具体材料，不据此为某片地区每个人赋予固定族群身份。

after.en:
Textiles from Myanmar connect cultivation, dyeing, weaving and exchange with the social meanings of clothing. Museum scientific work can identify materials and techniques that written political histories often leave unrecorded. Objects associated with Karen communities also challenge an account in which the whole region possesses one undifferentiated culture.

A collected textile has more than one history: production and use, transfer to a collection, and later scientific interpretation. The survival of an object does not establish the identity of every maker or every person who wore a similar pattern. Colonial-era collecting shaped what museums can now study and how it was classified.

A signed hanging by U Paw Hnyun adds a named maker and another textile practice to this history. Made about 1870–1885, its velvet ground carries appliqué, embroidery, sequins and metallic thread depicting Thiri Rama, the Burmese adaptation of the Ramayana. Rama, Sita and Ravana recur in selected scenes rather than a single continuous narrative, showing how textile work could also tell a literary story.

吴波纽署名的挂饰，为这段历史加入一位具名匠人与另一种纺织实践。这件约1870—1885年的作品以天鹅绒为底，结合贴布绣、刺绣、亮片与金属线，表现缅甸改编的《罗摩衍那》。罗摩、悉多与罗波那反复出现于选取的场景中，而非组成单一连续情节，展现织绣如何讲述文学故事。

before.en:
The Kakatiya kingdom provides another political sequence in the Deccan alongside the Hoysalas and Cholas. Its temple landscapes joined sacred architecture to cultivated land and engineered water storage. These relationships show how religious patronage depended on a wider working countryside.

At Palampet, construction of the Rudreshwara temple began in 1213. Carved pillars and bracket figures record regional dance imagery, while porous bricks reduced the roof’s weight. The nearby reservoir is part of the same historical setting. The surviving ensemble is evidence of practical engineering and specialized craft, as well as royal representation.
before.zh:
卡卡提亚王国为德干补上一条与曷萨拉、朱罗并行的政治序列。其寺庙景观将圣所、农田和人工蓄水设施相连，显示宗教资助依赖更广阔的生产性乡村。

帕兰佩特的鲁德雷湿瓦拉寺于1213年开工。雕刻柱与托架人像表现区域舞蹈，轻质多孔砖则减轻屋顶重量。附近水库属于同一历史环境。现存建筑群既体现王权表达，也留下实用工程与专业技艺的证据。

after.en:
The Kakatiya kingdom developed in the Deccan alongside the Hoysalas and Cholas. Its temple landscapes joined sacred architecture to cultivated land and engineered water storage. These relationships show how religious patronage depended on a wider working countryside.

At Palampet, construction of the Rudreshwara temple began in 1213. Carved pillars and bracket figures record regional dance imagery, while porous bricks reduced the roof’s weight. The nearby reservoir is part of the same historical setting. The surviving ensemble is evidence of practical engineering and specialized craft, as well as royal representation.

A twelfth–thirteenth-century stone image of Vishnu accompanied by Garuda and Lakshmi offers another view of Kakatiya-period carving. The standing deity, elaborate ornaments and smaller accompanying figures show how sculptors organized a divine group at monumental scale. The Met’s record associates the work with the Kakatiya period, but does not link it to the Rudreshwara temple at Palampet.
after.zh:
卡卡提亚王国在德干发展，与曷萨拉、朱罗并立。其寺庙景观将圣所、农田和人工蓄水设施相连，显示宗教资助依赖更广阔的生产性乡村。

一件十二至十三世纪毗湿奴与迦楼罗、吉祥天的石雕，为卡卡提亚时期雕刻提供另一视角。站立神祇、繁复饰物与较小的陪伴人物，展现雕工如何以纪念性尺度组织神祇群像。大都会馆录将其归于卡卡提亚时期，但未将它与帕兰佩特的鲁德雷什瓦拉寺联系起来。

before.en:
Caribbean societies grouped under the name Taíno developed island and inter-island relationships before European invasion. On Hispaniola, hereditary chiefs and subordinate leaders organized political relationships within several chiefdoms. Farming, fishing, craft production and exchange supported communities whose authority and ritual life cannot be understood through European descriptions alone.

The arrival of Spanish colonizers brought violence, forced labour, disease and upheaval. Colonial accounts later helped sustain the false impression that Native Caribbean peoples vanished. Smithsonian work with present-day descendants instead traces survival, cultural inheritance and movements asserting Indigenous identity. The label Taíno is useful but does not turn every island community into one uniform people or state. Archaeological evidence, colonial documents and descendant perspectives offer different kinds of information about the past and must be read together.
before.zh:
欧洲入侵前，被统称为泰诺的加勒比社会已经形成岛内及跨岛联系。在伊斯帕尼奥拉，世袭首领与下级领袖，在多个酋邦内组织政治关系。农耕、捕鱼、工艺和交换支持社群，不能只依欧洲描述理解其权威与仪式生活。

西班牙殖民者到来带来暴力、强迫劳动、疾病与剧变。殖民记载后来又助长原住民已经消失的错误印象。史密森学会与今日后裔合作，追踪延续、文化传承及主张原住民身份的运动。“泰诺”是有用标签，却不能把各岛社群变成统一民族或国家。考古、殖民文献和后裔立场提供不同性质的历史信息，需要结合阅读。

A stone zemí dated 1200–1500 offers a material view of ceremonial authority. Its deep eye sockets and slender body were deliberately carved; the Met interprets it as probably a stand used in cohoba ceremonies. Zemí refers to spiritual or vital force associated with deities and ancestors, connecting the object to relationships beyond its visible form.

一件年代为1200—1500年的石制泽米，让仪式权威具有可见的物质形态。深凹眼窝与细瘦身体经过刻意雕琢；大都会认为它可能是在科霍巴仪式中使用的承托器。泽米指与神祇和祖先相关的精神或生命力量，使物件联系到其可见形态之外的关系。

before.en:
Andean farmers worked within steep environmental contrasts rather than a single uniform agricultural zone. Terraces, irrigation and raised fields helped communities manage water and cultivable land, while crops and herds suited different elevations. Potatoes, quinoa and camelids belonged to systems of knowledge and selection accumulated over generations.

The Inca expanded existing practices and drew labour and produce into wider political arrangements; they did not invent every technique used within their empire. Contemporary agricultural heritage preserves evidence of continuing knowledge, but it cannot by itself date every ancient field. Comparing living practice with archaeology allows continuity to be discussed without assuming that nothing changed. Food production connected households to ceremonial centers, roads and state demands. Those relationships make agriculture part of political history as well as a background activity outside the story of rulers.
before.zh:
安第斯农民面对的是陡峭的环境差异，而非单一均质农区。梯田、灌溉与高畦田帮助社群管理水和耕地，作物与畜群则适应不同海拔。马铃薯、藜麦及骆驼科家畜，属于跨代积累的知识和选育体系。

印加扩展已有实践，并把劳动和产品纳入更广政治安排，并非发明帝国内全部技术。今日农业遗产保存持续知识的证据，却不能单独确定每块古田的年代。结合活态实践与考古，才能讨论延续而不假设从未变化。食物生产把家庭同仪式中心、道路及国家索求相连，使农业也是政治史的一部分，而不是统治者故事之外的背景劳动。

before.en:
The Kuba kingdom brought several communities and principalities into a political order associated in oral traditions with Shyaam aMbul aNgoong. A seventeenth-century consolidation provides a useful focus, but stories about a founder’s travels and innovations should be read as historical traditions rather than as an independently dated biography. Political authority operated through titles and offices as well as the king.

Agricultural production and access to regional resources supported courtly life. Raffia textiles, decorated vessels and prestige caps show how officeholders and patrons expressed rank through the work of artists. These objects connect government to cultivation, fiber processing and skilled labour. Comparing Kuba with Luba and Lunda demonstrates that central African political systems were related but not interchangeable. The selected endpoint is an editorial turn into the colonial era, not the disappearance of Kuba people, kingship or craft knowledge.
before.zh:
库巴王国将多个社区与较小政治体纳入一种政治秩序，口述传统把这一整合与夏姆·姆布尔·恩贡联系起来。十七世纪的整合提供了研究焦点，但有关创始者旅行和创新的故事应视作历史传统，而非已独立确定年代的传记。王权之外，称号与官职也组织政治权威。

农业生产及对区域资源的利用支撑宫廷生活。拉菲草织物、装饰器皿与威望帽显示官员和资助者如何借艺术家的劳动表达身份。这些物件把治理同种植、纤维加工及技艺劳动联系起来。与卢巴和隆达比较，可以看见中非政治制度既有关联，也不可互换。本条终点只是进入殖民时代的编辑分期，并不表示库巴人、王权或手工知识消失。

A mid-nineteenth-century Kuba wooden whistle adds sound to this material history. Its elongated form ends in a carved human head, combining an instrument with figural design. The museum places whistles in traditions of signaling and ensemble performance across sub-Saharan Africa; the recorded history of this particular instrument does not establish a specific royal ceremony.

before.en: Djenné-Djeno reveals a long urban history in the inland Niger delta before the better-known trading town of Djenné reached prominence. Excavated layers preserve changing domestic, craft and burial spaces, allowing archaeologists to reconstruct a settlement through everyday material evidence. The older mound and the present town are separate places with overlapping histories, not two names for an unchanged city. Pottery sequences and sediment cores indicate that occupation of the older settlement declined after about 1200 and ended around 1400. Archaeological dating remains approximate, and the relationship between this decline and the growth of nearby Djenné is an interpretation tested through continuing fieldwork.
before.zh: 杰内杰诺表明，在后来著名的贸易城镇杰内兴起之前，尼日尔河内陆三角洲已经拥有悠久的城市生活。发掘地层保存了不断变化的居住、手工业和墓葬空间，使考古学家能够从日常物质遗存重建聚落历史。旧遗址丘与今日杰内是历史相互交叠的两个地点，并非同一座始终未变的城市的不同名称。陶器序列与钻探资料显示，旧聚落约在1200年以后衰落，至1400年前后停止居住。年代仍是近似判断，旧城衰落与附近杰内发展的联系也属于有待持续考古检验的解释。

A thirteenth-century terracotta figure in the Met is attributed to Djenné-Djeno. With its arms gathered around a knee and its head lowered, it preserves a sculptor’s close attention to the human body. Such objects widen the picture of urban life beyond buildings and trade: they also record skilled artistic work, although this figure’s original purpose remains uncertain.

大都会收藏的一件十三世纪陶塑，被归于杰内杰诺。人物双臂环抱膝部、头部低垂，保存了雕塑者对人体的细致观察。这类物件使城市生活的图景超越建筑与贸易，也记录技艺劳动，但此像的原始用途仍不明确。

before.en:
Tyre, Sidon, Byblos and other Levantine cities participated in a maritime world connected through commerce and shared practices. They also competed with one another and negotiated relationships with powerful inland empires. The label Phoenician, inherited through Greek usage, should not be treated as the official name of one unified territorial country.

Movement of goods and craft traditions connected coastal communities with wider Mediterranean and Near Eastern settings. Such connections could survive changes in political subordination. Reading these cities beside Carthage and Assyria helps show how networks and empires overlapped without being the same kind of organization. This entry uses a broad Iron Age focus, ending at a major imperial transition for orientation. That endpoint does not imply that the cities, their inhabitants or their languages simply disappeared.
before.zh:
推罗、西顿、比布鲁斯等黎凡特城市通过商业和共享实践参与海洋世界，也彼此竞争，并与强大的内陆帝国协商关系。经希腊用法传下的“腓尼基”标签，不应被当作一个统一领土国家的正式名称。

货物与工艺流动把沿海社群同更广的地中海和近东环境相连，这些联系能够跨越政治隶属关系的变化。与迦太基、亚述并读，可观察网络与帝国如何重叠而又属于不同组织。本条采用宽泛的铁器时代范围，以一次重要帝国转折作为阅读终点，并不表示城市、居民或语言突然消失。

A seventh-century BCE trefoil jug makes these exchanges tangible. The Met identifies tall-necked jugs of this shape as frequent Phoenician imports into Cyprus, where potters also produced them in red- and black-slipped wares. An everyday vessel thus connects the movement of goods with the movement and local adaptation of craft forms.

货物与工艺流动把沿海社群同更广的地中海和近东环境相连，这些联系能够跨越政治隶属关系的变化。与迦太基、亚述并读，可观察网络与帝国如何重叠而又属于不同组织。本条采用宽泛的铁器时代范围，以一次重要帝国转折作为阅读终点，并不表示城市、居民或语言突然消失。

一件前七世纪三瓣口陶壶，使这种交流变得具体。大都会指出，此类长颈壶是塞浦路斯常见的腓尼基进口器物，当地陶工也以红色或黑色陶衣制作同类产品。日用容器因而将货物流动与工艺形制的传播、在地改造联系起来。

before.en:
The Ghurids began as chiefs in the mountains of central Afghanistan and became a major military power during the twelfth century. Their expansion reached from eastern Iranian lands toward northern India, competing with and displacing Ghaznavid rulers.

This was a short-lived imperial formation rather than an enduring state with one settled border. Persian literary and religious patronage linked its courts to the wider eastern Islamic world. Its collapse before the Mongol conquests and the emergence of successor military governments in South Asia show why political succession should be followed across regions, rather than stopping at a modern national border.
before.zh:
古尔王朝起于阿富汗中部山地酋长，在12世纪成为重要军事力量。其扩张从伊朗东部伸向北印度，与伽色尼统治者竞争并取而代之。

这是一个短暂的帝国组合，并非拥有稳定边界的持久国家。波斯文学与宗教资助把其宫廷接入更广泛的东方伊斯兰世界。蒙古征服之前的瓦解，以及南亚继承性军事政权的兴起，都说明政治更替需要跨区域追踪，而不能在现代国界处停止。

A group of molded, monochrome-glazed tiles from Ghazni provides evidence of building decoration during Ghurid rule. The Met dates the group to the early thirteenth century from excavation stratigraphy. This small hexagonal example carries an animal in relief, showing how ceramic workshops supplied patterned architectural surfaces.

加兹尼出土的一组模制单色釉砖，提供了古尔统治时期建筑装饰的证据。大都会根据发掘地层，将这组砖定于十三世纪初。这件小型六边形砖呈现动物浮雕，展示陶工作坊如何为建筑提供带有纹样的表面装饰。

before.en:
A reader could carry a classical text in a smaller book. In 1501, Aldus Manutius's Venetian press began issuing portable editions, including Virgil in April and Horace in May. The Virgil was the first complete book printed in the new italic type. Its letter shapes borrowed from humanist handwriting, giving printed pages something of a manuscript's appearance.

That design depended on Francesco Griffo, who cut the type. Examination of surviving copies shows that the letterforms continued to change while the Virgil was being printed. Publisher, type cutter and press workers were making a new reading object together. Placed after Gutenberg in the atlas, this story follows a different question: once books could be multiplied, how should they look and fit into a reader's life? Portability and typography were choices made through skilled work.
before.zh:
读者可以把古典作品装进一本较小的书随身携带。1501年，阿尔杜斯·马努提乌斯的威尼斯印刷坊开始推出便携版本，其中有四月的维吉尔和五月的贺拉斯。维吉尔集是第一部全书采用新斜体字印刷的书，字形借鉴人文主义者的手写体，让印页带有手稿的观感。

这种设计依赖雕刻字模的弗朗切斯科·格里福。对传世版本的比较表明，维吉尔集仍在印刷时，字形还在继续调整。出版者、刻字者与印工共同制作新的阅读物件。把本篇接在古腾堡之后，可以追问另一个问题：书籍能够成批印制以后，应当怎样呈现，又怎样进入读者生活？便携性与字体，都是通过熟练劳动做出的选择。

after.en:
A reader could carry a classical text in a smaller book. In 1501, Aldus Manutius's Venetian press began issuing portable editions, including Virgil in April and Horace in May. The Virgil was the first complete book printed in the new italic type. Its letter shapes borrowed from humanist handwriting, giving printed pages something of a manuscript's appearance.

That design depended on Francesco Griffo, who cut the type. Examination of surviving copies shows that the letterforms continued to change while the Virgil was being printed. Placed after Gutenberg in the atlas, this story follows a different question: once books could be multiplied, how should they look and fit into a reader's life? Portability and typography were choices made through skilled work.

Two years earlier, the same publisher and type designer had pursued another kind of book. Aldus’s December 1499 Hypnerotomachia Poliphili used roman type designed by Griffo and paired it with woodcut illustrations. Comparing this larger illustrated volume with the 1501 portable editions shows that their collaboration explored more than one relationship between page, lettering and reader.

两年前，同一位出版人与字体设计师曾探索另一类书籍。阿尔杜斯于1499年12月出版的《寻爱绮梦》，采用格里福设计的罗马体字，配以木刻插图。将这部较大的插图书与1501年便携版本对照，可见二人的合作曾探索页面、字形与读者之间的多种关系。

before.en:
Pilgrimage to Santiago de Compostela connected a religious destination with towns and rural communities across several routes. Churches, bridges, hospitals and hostels sustained travel, making belief visible in infrastructure and everyday work. The tomb’s identification with the apostle James is a religious tradition; it is not presented here as a verified archaeological identity.

Pilgrims and hosts exchanged objects, skills and stories, while commerce supported settlements along the routes. The network was neither one road nor a documented itinerary followed by every traveler. Its surviving buildings also come from different periods, so a medieval focus cannot date each monument identically. This entry brings religion, mobility and care into the same history as royal power. The 1000–1500 window selects medieval development, while pilgrimage and the communities along its routes continue beyond that interval.
before.zh:
前往圣地亚哥—德孔波斯特拉的巡礼，通过多条道路把宗教目的地与城市、乡村群体联系起来。教堂、桥梁、医院和旅舍支持旅行，使信仰体现为基础设施与日常劳动。墓葬被认作使徒雅各之墓属于宗教传统，本条不把它视为已经考古证实的身份。

巡礼者和接待者交换物品、技能与故事，商业活动也支持沿线聚落。这一网络既不是单一道路，也不是每位旅行者都遵循的有记录行程。现存建筑来自不同时代，因此不能用同一个中世纪日期标记每座建筑。本条把宗教、流动和照护纳入与王权并列的历史。1000—1500年用于选取中世纪发展阶段，巡礼及沿线群体在此后仍然延续。

A French limestone statue made about 1450–1475 shows James himself dressed as a pilgrim, with a shell on his hat and a book in his hand. The staff is now missing. Made at Poligny in Burgundy, the sculpture shows the saint’s recognizable pilgrim imagery beyond the Spanish destination, alongside the routes and buildings that sustained travel.

一尊约1450—1475年制作的法国石灰石像，将雅各本人装扮为朝圣者：帽上带贝壳，手中持书，手杖现已失落。此像制作于勃艮第的波利尼，展现圣人的朝圣图像如何出现在西班牙目的地之外，与维系旅行的道路和建筑并存。

before.en:
The revocation of the Edict of Nantes in 1685 intensified the persecution of French Protestants and encouraged flight. Refugees reached England through dangerous and uneven journeys, then faced the practical work of securing shelter, support and employment. Community institutions and commercial connections helped some newcomers establish livelihoods, but a success story cannot stand for every refugee’s experience.

Isaac Minet’s account of detention, escape and settlement provides one documented case. Written decades after his arrival, it also shows how memory and religious conviction shaped a migrant’s narrative about his earlier life. His story should be compared with administrative records and other voices rather than treated as a complete demographic picture. The entry connects European religious conflict with craft, business and family history, and gives migration a place alongside the wars and treaties of the same period.
before.zh:
1685年废除南特敕令，加剧了法国新教徒受到的迫害，并推动逃离。难民经过危险且各不相同的旅程抵达英格兰，随后必须寻找住所、援助与工作。共同体机构和商业联系帮助部分新来者建立生计，但成功故事不能代表所有难民的经验。

伊萨克·米内关于拘禁、逃亡与定居的叙述，是一个有记录的个案。该文写于抵达数十年后，也显示记忆与宗教信念如何塑造移民对早年生活的讲述。应将其与行政文书及其他声音比较，而不能视为完整人口图景。本条把欧洲宗教冲突与工艺、商业和家庭历史联系起来，使迁徙与同时期战争及条约并列进入历史。

The next generation can be followed through Paul de Lamerie, born in the Low Countries to Huguenot emigrants and brought to London as a child. His 1738/39 tea caddies and sugar box, made just after this entry’s focus window, display richly worked silver for an aristocratic household. They connect migration and skilled work with elite consumption of tea and sugar.

下一代的经历可由保罗·德·拉梅里追踪：他在低地国家出生，父母为胡格诺移民，幼年随家迁往伦敦。其1738/39年的茶叶罐与糖盒制作于本条目时间范围稍后，为贵族家庭展现精巧银工，将移民、熟练劳动与精英阶层的茶糖消费联系起来。

before.en: Born enslaved in Saint-Domingue, Toussaint Louverture became a central military and political leader of the Haitian Revolution. He was already free before the uprising of 1791 and had himself participated in the plantation economy. His shifting alliances reflected a struggle over emancipation, imperial power, and the survival of a revolutionary state. In 1801 a constitution made him governor for life while retaining a formal connection to France. His coercive agricultural policies reveal tensions between freedom and economic reconstruction. Captured and deported by French forces, he died in prison in 1803, before Haitian independence. His career makes abolition a difficult political process rather than a simple story of one liberating hero.
before.zh: 杜桑·卢维杜尔出生时在圣多明各受到奴役，后来成为海地革命的重要军事与政治领袖。1791年起义前，他已获得自由，也曾参与种植园经济。他不断变化的联盟体现了围绕解放、帝国权力与革命政权生存的斗争。1801年宪法使他成为终身总督，同时保留与法国的形式联系。他强制恢复农业生产的政策，显示自由与经济重建之间的矛盾。被法国军队逮捕并押送法国后，他于1803年死于监狱，未见海地独立。他的经历使废奴呈现为复杂政治过程，而非单一英雄的故事。

after.en:
Born enslaved in Saint-Domingue, Toussaint Louverture became a central military and political leader of the Haitian Revolution. He was already free before the uprising of 1791 and had himself participated in the plantation economy. His shifting alliances reflected a struggle over emancipation, imperial power, and the survival of a revolutionary state. In 1801 a constitution made him governor for life while retaining a formal connection to France. His coercive agricultural policies reveal tensions between freedom and economic reconstruction. Captured and deported by French forces, he died in prison in 1803, before Haitian independence. His career makes abolition a difficult political process rather than a simple story of one liberating hero.

Around 1802, Claude Louis Desrais drew Toussaint on a rearing horse as a model for a published print. The Met doubts its value as a likeness: the artist probably never saw him. The drawing instead shows how European conventions of military command shaped the image of a revolutionary leader.
after.zh:

约1802年，克洛德·路易·德雷绘制了骑腾跃战马的杜桑，为出版版画提供底稿。大都会对其容貌准确性存疑：画家可能从未见过本人。这幅画更能说明欧洲军事统帅惯例如何塑造革命领袖的形象。

before.en: An uprising of enslaved people in Saint-Domingue transformed a profitable French plantation colony into an independent state. The struggle intertwined abolition, civil rights, rival revolutionary projects and intervention by European powers. Toussaint Louverture emerged as a major leader, while Jean-Jacques Dessalines led the final break with France after renewed attempts to impose colonial control. The revolution challenged the contradiction between proclamations of liberty and economies built on slavery. Foreign governments’ reactions also exposed the interests behind their principles: the United States delayed recognition until 1862. Haitian independence was won through the decisions and sacrifices of people whom colonial society had denied political standing.
before.zh: 圣多明各被奴役者的起义，将法国获利丰厚的种植园殖民地变成独立国家。废奴、公民权、不同革命方案与欧洲列强干预相互交织。杜桑·卢维杜尔成为重要领袖；法国再次试图恢复殖民控制后，德萨林领导最终决裂。革命揭露自由宣言与奴隶经济的矛盾，外国反应也显示原则背后的利益，美国直到1862年才承认海地。独立来自被殖民秩序剥夺政治地位者的行动与牺牲。

after.en:
An uprising of enslaved people in Saint-Domingue transformed a profitable French plantation colony into an independent state. The struggle intertwined abolition, civil rights, rival revolutionary projects and intervention by European powers. Toussaint Louverture emerged as a major leader, while Jean-Jacques Dessalines led the final break with France after renewed attempts to impose colonial control. The revolution challenged the contradiction between proclamations of liberty and economies built on slavery. Foreign governments’ reactions also exposed the interests behind their principles: the United States delayed recognition until 1862. Haitian independence was won through the decisions and sacrifices of people whom colonial society had denied political standing.

The revolution also generated images for distant audiences. A drawing of Toussaint on horseback, attributed to Claude Louis Desrais and dated about 1802, was used for a published print. Its military symbolism is clearer than its value as a likeness, since the artist probably never met Toussaint.
after.zh:

革命也催生了面向远方观众的图像。一幅归于克洛德·路易·德雷、约1802年的杜桑骑马图，被用于出版版画。画家可能从未见过杜桑，因此它的军事象征比容貌真实性更明确。

before.en:
The Almoravid movement developed in the western Saharan world and established a ruling dynasty in Morocco. Marrakesh became its political center. Expansion linked Saharan routes with ports and cities on both sides of the western Mediterranean.

The dynasty entered al-Andalus after Christian forces took Toledo and assumed control of its Muslim kingdoms. Religious reform did not prevent participation in sophisticated textile and architectural production. This cross-strait history belongs to both North Africa and Iberia; a modern continental division should not divide the political sequence into unrelated stories.
before.zh:
穆拉比特运动发端于撒哈拉西部，并在摩洛哥建立统治王朝。马拉喀什成为政治中心。扩张把撒哈拉商路与西地中海两岸的港口和城市联系起来。

基督教军队取得托莱多后，该王朝进入安达卢斯并控制当地穆斯林王国。宗教改革并未妨碍精细织物与建筑生产。跨海峡历史同时属于北非与伊比利亚；现代大陆划分不应把同一政治序列割成互不相关的故事。

Religious reform did not prevent participation in sophisticated textile and architectural production. This cross-strait history belongs to both North Africa and Iberia; a modern continental division should not divide the political sequence into unrelated stories.

A silk fragment preserved at the shrine of San Librada in Sigüenza Cathedral shows paired griffins inside roundels. Dated to the first half of the twelfth century, it belongs to the luxurious weaving associated with Almoravid al-Andalus. The Met suggests such textiles reached Sigüenza after Alfonso VII captured Almería in 1147, linking craft production, warfare and reuse in a Christian shrine.
after.zh:
穆拉比特运动发端于撒哈拉西部，并在摩洛哥建立统治王朝。马拉喀什成为政治中心。扩张把撒哈拉商路与西地中海两岸的港口和城市联系起来。

基督教军队取得托莱多后，该王朝进入安达卢斯并控制当地穆斯林王国。宗教改革并未妨碍精细织物与建筑生产。跨海峡历史同时属于北非与伊比利亚；现代大陆划分不应把同一政治序列割成互不相关的故事。

锡古恩萨主教座堂圣利布拉达圣龛保存的一块丝织残片，在圆形纹样中表现成对狮鹫。其年代为十二世纪上半叶，属于与穆拉比特时期安达卢斯相联系的精美织造。大都会认为这类织物可能在阿方索七世1147年攻占阿尔梅里亚后到达锡古恩萨，把手工生产、战争与基督教圣龛中的再利用联系起来。

before.en: Simón Bolívar helped lead the wars that broke Spanish imperial rule in much of northern South America. His campaigns depended on regional armies, local alliances, and international support, including assistance from Haiti. Born into a wealthy slave-owning family, he came to connect independence with emancipation, although the transition remained incomplete and contested. Military victory did not settle how new republics should distribute power or preserve unity. His preference for a strong executive created tensions with other republican visions, while the larger political union he supported fragmented. Reading Bolívar alongside these disagreements makes independence a beginning of new political struggles rather than a clean endpoint to colonial history.
before.zh: 西蒙·玻利瓦尔参与领导战争，使南美北部大片地区摆脱西班牙帝国统治。他的军事行动依靠地方军队、区域联盟和包括海地援助在内的国际支持。出生于富有的奴隶主家庭后，他逐渐把独立与解放联系起来，但这一转变并不完整，也充满争议。军事胜利未能解决新共和国如何分配权力、维持统一的问题。他对强大行政权的偏好，与其他共和主义方案存在张力，其支持的较大政治联盟也最终分裂。把这些争论纳入他的经历，能把独立看作新政治斗争的开端，而非殖民史的整齐终点。

His public image continued to travel after his death. An 1884–1898 stereograph records R.de la Cora’s equestrian statue of Bolívar in New York’s Central Park. The paired photographic views document posthumous commemoration, not his appearance from life or an eyewitness scene of the independence wars.

before.en: Opposition to Porfirio Díaz’s long rule developed into revolution, but removing him did not unite the country behind one program. Francisco Madero sought political change, while Emiliano Zapata demanded the return of land and other leaders mobilized different regional interests. Coups, assassinations and civil war followed. The Constitution of 1917 expressed ambitious commitments concerning labor, communal land and national control of subsoil resources, although implementing them took much longer. The revolution also drew in the United States and moved people across the border. Its history separates constitutional promises from the contested work of turning them into lived conditions.
before.zh: 反对迪亚斯长期统治的力量发展为革命，但推翻他并未使全国接受同一纲领。马德罗追求政治改革，萨帕塔要求归还土地，其他领袖动员不同地方利益，随后出现政变、暗杀与内战。1917年宪法提出劳动权、社群土地和地下资源国家控制等目标，但落实历时更久。美国也卷入其中，人口跨境流动。革命史必须区分宪法承诺与把承诺变为现实的复杂斗争。

after.en:

Francisco Madero sought political change, while Emiliano Zapata demanded the return of land and other leaders mobilized different regional interests. Coups, assassinations and civil war followed. The Constitution of 1917 expressed ambitious commitments concerning labor, communal land and national control of subsoil resources, although implementing them took much longer. The revolution also drew in the United States and moved people across the border. Its history separates constitutional promises from the contested work of turning them into lived conditions.

Printed sheets turned political leaders into widely circulated images. A Posada broadsheet published around 1911 celebrates Madero’s early victory through a mounted figure, supporters and verse. A separate Posada image identifies Zapata; the surviving Met sheet is a later impression. Comparing them distinguishes contemporary celebration from subsequent reproduction, without treating either print as a neutral photograph of the revolution.
after.zh:

印刷单页把政治领袖转化为广泛传播的形象。波萨达约1911年出版的单页，通过骑马人物、支持者与诗句庆祝马德罗的早期胜利。另一幅波萨达图像表现萨帕塔，但大都会所藏纸本为后印。比较两者可区分当时的庆祝与后来的复制，而不把任何一幅版画当作革命的中立照片。

before.en:
Quipu, or khipu, used cords and knots to organize information in the Inka world. Colours, positions and types of knots could distinguish categories and numerical values. Specialists known as quipucamayocs managed records needed for populations, production and labour obligations. Recording was therefore part of how administration mobilized people and goods, not simply a mathematical curiosity.

Surviving examples demonstrate numerical organization, while the range of information encoded and the possibilities of non-numerical recording remain subjects of research. Claims that all quipu have been deciphered exceed the evidence. The system connected material practice, trained memory and institutional work in a society that did not rely on an alphabetic bureaucracy like Spain’s. Comparing it with manuscripts elsewhere reveals several ways to preserve knowledge without ranking peoples by whether their records resemble European books.
before.zh:
结绳 quipu 或 khipu 运用绳索和绳结组织印加世界的信息。颜色、位置与结型可以区分类别和数值。称为 quipucamayoc 的专家，管理人口、生产和劳动义务记录。因此，记录是行政调动人与物的方式，不只是数学奇观。

遗存证明其数值组织功能，但信息范围及非数值记录的可能性仍是研究问题，不能声称全部结绳已经被解读。这个体系把材料实践、训练记忆与机构劳动相连，不依赖西班牙式字母官僚文书。同其他地区手稿比较，可以看到保存知识的多种方式，而不以记录是否像欧洲书籍来给民族排序。

An Inka quipu dated to before 1532 in Princeton’s collection consists of undyed cotton that was spun, plied and knotted. Its surviving strands make the physical work of arranging information visible. The catalog does not identify what this particular set of cords recorded, so the object demonstrates a recording medium without supplying a deciphered message.

before.en: Han rulers rebuilt imperial power after Qin’s fall, developing a bureaucracy and a political culture shaped by classical learning. Chang’an became a major capital, while diplomacy and military campaigns linked the court with Central Asia. Sima Qian’s historical writing helped establish models for later dynastic histories. Elite tombs preserve household models, entertainment and beliefs about the afterlife, revealing social worlds beyond government alone. Han rule was interrupted by the Xin dynasty and later restored from Luoyang. Its institutional legacy lasted much longer than any stable set of imperial borders.
before.zh: 汉在秦亡后重建帝国，以官僚制度和经典学问塑造政治文化。长安成为大都会，外交与战争又将朝廷和中亚联系起来。司马迁的著述为后世史书提供重要范式。墓葬中的住宅、乐舞和来世形象，还展现了政治之外的社会生活。汉的统治曾被新朝打断，后来以洛阳为都城恢复；制度影响远比某一时刻的疆界持久。

after.en:

Chang’an became a major capital, while diplomacy and military campaigns linked the court with Central Asia. Sima Qian’s historical writing helped establish models for later dynastic histories. Han rule was interrupted by the Xin dynasty and later restored from Luoyang. Its institutional legacy lasted much longer than any stable set of imperial borders.

A pottery granary model makes that funerary household concrete. Its cylindrical body and roof turn a building for stored grain into a small burial object. The Met identifies such farm-building models as provisions for the afterlife, linking agricultural resources with elite expectations beyond death.
after.zh:
汉在秦亡后重建帝国，以官僚制度和经典学问塑造政治文化。长安成为大都会，外交与战争又将朝廷和中亚联系起来。司马迁的著述为后世史书提供重要范式。墓葬中的住宅、乐舞和来世形象，还展现了政治之外的社会生活。汉的统治曾被新朝打断，后来以洛阳为都城恢复；制度影响远比某一时刻的疆界持久。

陶粮仓模型将墓葬中的家产具体化：筒形仓身与屋顶把储粮建筑缩为小型随葬物。大都会指出，此类农用建筑模型供来世生活所需，将农业资源与墓主人死后的生活期待联系起来。

before.en: Tang Chang’an was a meeting place for diplomats, merchants, monks and artists from across Eurasia. Imperial patronage supported poetry, painting and religious institutions, while imported fashions and objects reveal the movement of people and ideas. The court’s reach changed considerably over time. The An Lushan rebellion weakened central authority, yet Tang rule and cultural production continued for generations. This is a history of both exchange and conflict: the same networks that carried valued goods also operated within rivalries, military campaigns and changing relationships between the capital and regional powers.
before.zh: 唐长安汇聚欧亚各地使节、商人、僧侣与艺术家。皇室支持诗歌、绘画和宗教事业，外来服饰与器物又见证人员与观念流动。朝廷的影响范围并非一成不变；安史之乱削弱中央权威，但唐的统治与文化创造仍延续多代。这既是交流史，也是冲突史：商品和思想的网络始终处于战争、竞争及中央与地方关系的变化之中。

after.en:

Imperial patronage supported poetry, painting and religious institutions, while imported fashions and objects reveal the movement of people and ideas. The court’s reach changed considerably over time. The An Lushan rebellion weakened central authority, yet Tang rule and cultural production continued for generations. This is a history of both exchange and conflict: the same networks that carried valued goods also operated within rivalries, military campaigns and changing relationships between the capital and regional powers.

An eighth-century ceramic camel gives this history of exchange a material counterpart. Classified as tomb pottery, the two-humped figure carries the animal into a funerary setting. Its sancai glaze belongs to Tang ceramic production; the surviving model records an artistic choice, not the route or cargo of a specific caravan.

八世纪陶骆驼为交流史提供了实物对照。馆录将这件双峰骆驼归为明器，动物由此进入墓葬语境。三彩釉属于唐代陶瓷工艺；存世模型记录工匠的塑造选择，而非特定商队的路线或货物。

before.en: The Joseon ruling house promoted Neo-Confucian learning as a framework for government and social life. The early dynasty reorganized political institutions and reduced the privileged position of Buddhist establishments. Court and elite patronage supported painting, ceramics and books, while the creation of the Korean alphabet enlarged the possibilities of writing Korean. These achievements did not erase hierarchy or make access to education equal. Joseon offers a long view of how a state can use ideas, texts and rituals to shape society. Its final decades involved imperial transformation and increasing Japanese control.
before.zh: 朝鲜王朝以性理学塑造政府与社会秩序，早期重组政治制度，并限制佛教机构的特权。宫廷与士人支持绘画、陶瓷和书籍，韩文字母的创造也扩展了书写本国语言的可能。但文化成就并不意味着等级消失或教育机会平等。其长期历史展现国家如何借思想、文本和仪式组织社会；末期则经历帝国转型与日本控制加强。

An eighteenth-century porcelain jar connects this history to the potter’s workshop. Its body was formed by joining two hemispheres, leaving a subtly uneven silhouette. The museum explains that such vessels were utilitarian “big jars” in Joseon times; their later rediscovery and naming as moon jars changed how people valued them.

十八世纪白瓷罐将这段历史带入陶工作坊。器身由两个半球接合而成，轮廓略有不匀。馆方指出，这类器物在朝鲜王朝原为实用的“大罐”；后来被重新发现并称为月亮罐，其受珍视的方式也随之改变。

before.en: After Napoleon's first defeat, European powers met in Vienna to negotiate a political settlement. The Final Act reorganized territories and recognized arrangements including the German Confederation; questions concerning Poland and Saxony exposed competing dynastic and strategic interests. The agreement was signed before the Battle of Waterloo, so the settlement cannot simply be described as a reaction to that battle. Vienna shows how treaties combine legal claims, military leverage and compromise. Its boundaries need to be read alongside the interests of people living in the territories assigned by diplomats.
before.zh: 拿破仑首次战败后，欧洲列强在维也纳会商政治安排。《最后议定书》重新划分领土，并确认德意志邦联等制度；波兰与萨克森问题凸显不同王朝和战略利益的竞争。议定书在滑铁卢战役之前已经签署，因此不能简单说成是该战役的结果。维也纳会议显示条约如何结合法律主张、军事力量与妥协；阅读外交官划定的边界时，还应考虑被划入这些领土的人们。

after.en:
After Napoleon's first defeat, European powers met in Vienna to negotiate a political settlement. The Final Act reorganized territories and recognized arrangements including the German Confederation; questions concerning Poland and Saxony exposed competing dynastic and strategic interests. The agreement was signed before the Battle of Waterloo, so the settlement cannot simply be described as a reaction to that battle. Vienna shows how treaties combine legal claims, military leverage and compromise. Its boundaries need to be read alongside the interests of people living in the territories assigned by diplomats.

An 1819 engraving by Jean Godefroy after Jean-Baptiste Isabey assembled the congress into a group portrait. Men gather around a table within a border of portraits and emblems. The composition makes the diplomats visible while also showing how an image produced after negotiations could organize their public memory.
after.zh:

让·戈德弗鲁瓦据伊萨贝原作制作的1819年铜版画，将会议组织为群像：男子聚于桌边，肖像与纹章构成边框。这种构图让外交官变得可见，也展示谈判结束后的图像如何组织公众记忆。

before.en:
The revolutionary upheavals of 1848 opened space for a German national assembly in Frankfurt. Representatives debated political rights, the shape of a proposed state and the relationship between a legislature and a monarch. Political clubs within the assembly expressed competing liberal, democratic and conservative programs rather than one agreed national will.

The project also exposed limits of representation: elections centered on adult independent men, with different procedures in different states. The assembly adopted fundamental rights and a constitution, but the Prussian king refused the imperial crown offered to him in 1849. Reviving monarchical power and military force defeated the constitutional project. Its failure was not an absence of political experimentation. Documents and debates allow comparison with later unification and constitutions, showing that national institutions could be proposed, contested and suppressed before a state possessing them actually existed.
before.zh:
1848年的革命动荡，为法兰克福德国国民议会的召开打开空间。代表们讨论政治权利、拟议国家的形式，以及立法机关与君主的关系。议会内不同政治社团表达自由派、民主派和保守派的竞争方案，并非同一种已经形成的民族意志。

这一项目也显露代表制度的局限：选举围绕具有独立身份的成年男性展开，各邦程序不同。议会通过基本权利与宪法，但普鲁士国王在1849年拒绝所授帝冠。恢复力量的君主政府与军事行动，击败了宪制项目。失败不等于没有政治实验。文书与辩论可与后来的统一和宪法比较，说明在真正具备这些制度的国家出现之前，国家制度已可能被提出、争论并遭压制。

after.en:
The revolutionary upheavals of 1848 opened space for a German national assembly in Frankfurt. Representatives debated political rights, the shape of a proposed state and the relationship between a legislature and a monarch. Political clubs within the assembly expressed competing liberal, democratic and conservative programs rather than one agreed national will.

The project also exposed limits of representation: elections centered on adult independent men, with different procedures in different states. The assembly adopted fundamental rights and a constitution, but the Prussian king refused the imperial crown offered to him in 1849. Reviving monarchical power and military force defeated the constitutional project. Its failure was not an absence of political experimentation. Documents and debates allow comparison with later unification and constitutions, showing that national institutions could be proposed, contested and suppressed before a state possessing them actually existed.

A coloured lithograph issued in 1848 shows the assembly’s chamber with curving rows of deputies and spectators above them. Flags and drapery turn the interior into a stage for national representation. The image preserves the public setting of the experiment, while the entry’s electoral history explains who could actually participate.
after.zh:
1848年的革命动荡，为法兰克福德国国民议会的召开打开空间。代表们讨论政治权利、拟议国家的形式，以及立法机关与君主的关系。议会内不同政治社团表达自由派、民主派和保守派的竞争方案，并非同一种已经形成的民族意志。

1848年出版的彩色石版画表现议会会场：议员席弧形展开，上方是旁听人群。旗帜与帷幔将室内空间转为民族代表政治的舞台。图像保存这一尝试的公开场景，而选举制度史说明谁真正能够参与。
