before.en: Shah Abbas I moved the Safavid capital to Isfahan in 1597–1598 and reshaped the city through a new ceremonial square, connected bazaars and major buildings. Royal audience space, mosques and the entrance to the commercial district placed several institutions of government and urban life around one public setting. Court sponsorship also supported painting, manuscripts and decorative arts. The design made connections between commerce and royal authority visible, while the older city remained part of the larger urban system. Construction continued beyond Abbas’s reign, so the square’s surviving ensemble should be read as a developing project rather than a single finished moment.
before.zh: 阿拔斯一世于1597—1598年将萨法维都城迁至伊斯法罕，并通过新礼仪广场、相连的集市及大型建筑重塑城市。王室觐见空间、清真寺和商业区入口，把政府与城市生活的多种机构汇聚在同一公共环境中。宫廷也赞助绘画、手稿和装饰艺术。规划使商业与王权之间的联系可见，而旧城仍属于更大的城市体系。工程在阿拔斯统治结束后继续，因此现存广场建筑群应被视为逐步发展的项目，而非一个瞬间完成的整体。

after.en:

The design made connections between commerce and royal authority visible, while the older city remained part of the larger urban system. Construction continued beyond Abbas’s reign, so the square’s surviving ensemble should be read as a developing project rather than a single finished moment.

Luigi Pesce photographed the square in 1858 using a paper negative. The surviving salted-paper print sets the open space against arcades, entrances, a dome and minarets. Its much later date separates the Safavid building project from the nineteenth-century city that photography could record.

路易吉·佩谢于1858年以纸负片拍摄广场。存世盐纸照片将开放空间与连拱、入口、圆顶和宣礼塔并置。拍摄年代远晚于萨法维建设工程，因而呈现的是摄影所能记录的十九世纪城市。

before.en:
Greek works reached Arabic readers through several routes, often involving Syriac versions, revisions and the labor of more than one translator. Scholars selected, compared and adapted texts for new audiences. The resulting movement depended on patrons and scholarly communities whose religious affiliations and languages were varied, rather than a single homogeneous group preserving a fixed body of knowledge.

Attributions can be uncertain: a work credited to one translator may survive only in another person’s revision, or be known through a bibliographic notice after the text itself has been lost. Such distinctions matter for understanding intellectual change. This entry therefore describes a network of activity and avoids treating every translation as a product of one institution called the House of Wisdom. Translation made new arguments possible; it was not merely the physical transportation of books.
before.zh:
希腊著作通过多种途径到达阿拉伯语读者，常涉及叙利亚语版本、修订及不止一位译者的劳动。学者选择、比较和调整文本，以面对新读者。这一运动依赖宗教归属和语言各异的资助者与学术社群，而非一个同质群体保存固定知识。

译者归属有时不确定：署于一人名下的作品，可能只留下他人修订本，或原文已失、仅见书目记载。这些区别关系到如何理解思想变化。本条因此描述活动网络，不把每次翻译都归于一所名叫“智慧宫”的机构。翻译使新论证成为可能，不只是书籍的实物搬运。

一份1224年的迪奥斯科里德斯阿拉伯文插图手稿，为这条传播链提供后世实物见证。归于巴格达的场景中，人物在器皿架下制备蜂蜜药物。抄写、绘图与阅读使译介知识在初译之后长期被使用；此页并非原译者亲笔稿。

before.en:
A Marshallese navigation chart can look unlike a paper map. Curved sticks and shells bring relationships among swells and islands into a form that a learner can study. Navigators memorized such charts on land; the objects were not simply carried aboard as route maps.

The Library of Congress holds three examples made in Majuro during the 1920s. A mattang teaches wave–island relationships, while rebbelib and meddo charts show broader or more limited island groups. They should not be read as scale drawings or interchangeable keys to every Pacific navigation tradition.

This is living knowledge as well as museum history. Waan Aelõñ in Majel documents Marshallese teaching through canoe work and navigation, including Captain Joel Korent using charts with learners. The making date of an object is not the beginning or end of the knowledge it helps transmit.
before.zh:
马绍尔群岛的航海图，可能完全不像纸上的地图。弯曲枝条与贝壳，将涌浪和岛屿之间的关系变成可以学习的形式。航海者在陆上记忆这类图表，而不是简单地把它们带上船当作航线图。

美国国会图书馆保存三件1920年代在马朱罗制作的例子。mattang用于教学，呈现波浪与岛屿的关系；rebbelib和meddo则描绘较广或较小的岛群范围。它们不应被当作按比例绘制的图，也不能用来概括所有太平洋航海传统。

这既是馆藏历史，也是活态知识。Waan Aelõñ in Majel记录了通过独木舟制作与航海开展的马绍尔教学，其中包括船长Joel Korent用图表指导学员。文物的制作年代，并不代表它所传授知识的起点或终点。

before.en:
Jayavarman VII ruled in the Angkorian world and supported Mahayana Buddhist patronage. Sculptural programs associated with his reign placed Buddhist imagery within royal landscapes. Their interpretation requires attention to temples, patrons and changing religious purposes rather than assuming that every surviving face is a portrait of the king.

A fragmentary Buddha sheltered by a naga, discussed by the Metropolitan Museum, provides evidence for the patronage environment, not a complete biography. Angkor’s broader remains place that object within a landscape of capitals and monumental construction. Together they show how royal representation drew on religious forms and skilled production. The surviving image world makes certain aspects of authority visible while leaving much of the labor and negotiation sustaining the court less directly recorded.
before.zh:
阇耶跋摩七世统治于吴哥世界，并支持大乘佛教资助。与其在位阶段相关的造像体系，把佛教形象置于王室景观之中。解释时应注意寺院、施主及变化的宗教用途，不能假定每张存世面孔都是国王肖像。

大都会博物馆讨论的一件龙王护佛残像，提供资助环境的证据，而非完整传记。吴哥更广的遗存使这件器物进入都城与大型营建景观。两者共同显示，王权表象如何依靠宗教形式与专业生产。存世图像使权威的某些方面可见，支撑宫廷的许多劳动和协商却较少被直接记录。

after.en:
Jayavarman VII supported Mahayana Buddhism in the Angkorian world. Temples and sculptural programs placed Buddhist imagery within royal landscapes.

A sandstone Buddha fragment sheltered by seven naga heads (Met 36.96.5) dates to the late twelfth–early thirteenth century. The museum connects this fragment with the artistic environment of his Buddhist patronage at Angkor Thom. It represents the Buddha, not a portrait of the king.
after.zh:
阇耶跋摩七世在吴哥世界支持大乘佛教。寺院与造像体系将佛教形象置于王室景观之中。

一件七首那伽护佑的砂岩佛像残件（大都会36.96.5），年代为十二世纪晚期至十三世纪初。馆方将它与吴哥通城中这一国王资助佛教的艺术环境联系起来。造像表现的是佛陀，并非国王肖像。

before.en:
An Ainu robe in the Metropolitan Museum is made from elm fiber, with applied cloth and embroidery shaping its surface. The nineteenth-century garment brings work into view: obtaining bark, preparing thread, weaving, cutting and stitching. The museum describes women’s central roles in designing and making such robes. The object’s individual maker is unrecorded, but that absence need not make the labor invisible.

Clothing also belonged to a changing landscape. The Ainu Association describes the colonial administration established in Hokkaido in 1869 and the subsequent taking of Ainu land. The robe preserves material knowledge carried through those changes. Reading it beside Chiri Yukie’s later work with oral tradition connects different forms of cultural expression while keeping cloth, language and their makers’ histories distinct.
before.zh:
大都会艺术博物馆收藏的一件阿伊努长衣，以榆树纤维织成，再用贴布与刺绣组织表面纹样。这件十九世纪衣物让多道劳动进入视野：取得树皮、制线、织布、裁剪、缝制。馆方介绍女性在设计和制作此类衣物中的重要作用。具体制作者的姓名没有记录，劳动本身却仍能从材料和针脚中读出。

衣物也属于不断变化的社会环境。北海道阿伊努协会记述了1869年北海道殖民行政机构的设立，以及此后阿伊努土地被夺取的过程。长衣保存了穿越这些变化的材料知识。把它与知里幸惠后来整理口述传统的工作并读，可以联系不同的文化表达，同时保留织物、语言及其传承者各自的历史。

after.en:
An Ainu robe (Met 1999.247.1), shown here from the back, is made from elm fiber, with applied cloth and embroidery shaping its surface. The nineteenth-century garment brings work into view: obtaining bark, preparing thread, weaving, cutting and stitching. The museum describes women’s central roles in designing and making such robes. The individual maker’s name is unrecorded.

Clothing also belonged to a changing landscape. The Ainu Association describes the colonial administration established in Hokkaido in 1869 and the subsequent taking of Ainu land. The robe preserves material knowledge carried through those changes.

before.en:
Hunayn ibn Ishaq was a Christian scholar whose translation and medical work linked Greek, Syriac and Arabic learned traditions. His activity involved the comparison of texts and collaboration with pupils and associates, including his son Ishaq. A translation could be revised or transmitted through another language before reaching the version known to later readers.

The history therefore requires attention to particular works and uncertain attributions, rather than treating every later medical text as his direct product. His contribution sits within a larger network of patrons, physicians and readers. Linking this biography to the Abbasid and translation entries makes intellectual exchange a form of sustained labor. It also shows that religious diversity and cooperation existed within scholarly settings without implying that social relations were universally equal or free of conflict.
before.zh:
侯奈因·伊本·伊斯哈格是一位基督教学者，其翻译和医学工作连接希腊语、叙利亚语和阿拉伯语的学问传统。活动涉及文本比较，也涉及与学生、同事及其子伊斯哈格合作。译本可能经过修订或另一语言中转，才成为后世读者所知的版本。

因此需要关注具体作品和不确定的译者归属，不能把后来的每部医学文本都视为他直接完成。他的贡献位于资助者、医生和读者构成的更大网络。与阿拔斯、翻译运动条目相连，可把思想交换理解为持续劳动，也显示学术环境中的宗教多样性与合作，而不暗示社会关系普遍平等或没有冲突。

after.en:
Hunayn ibn Ishaq was a Christian scholar whose translation and medical work linked Greek, Syriac and Arabic learned traditions. His activity involved the comparison of texts and collaboration with pupils and associates, including his son Ishaq. A translation could be revised or transmitted through another language before reaching the version known to later readers.

A later Latin witness survives as Wellcome MS.390, an early-fourteenth-century copy of the Isagoge in Tegni Galeni attributed to Johannitius, Hunayn’s Latin name. Red initials distinguish sections, while marginal notes preserve later readers’ engagement. Its medieval copying and annotation belong to the text’s transmission history, not to Hunayn’s own hand.
after.zh:
侯奈因·伊本·伊斯哈格是一位基督教学者，其翻译和医学工作连接希腊语、叙利亚语和阿拉伯语的学问传统。活动涉及文本比较，也涉及与学生、同事及其子伊斯哈格合作。译本可能经过修订或另一语言中转，才成为后世读者所知的版本。

以侯奈因的拉丁名约翰尼提乌斯署名的《盖伦医术导论》，存有惠康MS.390这一十四世纪初拉丁文抄本。红色首字母区分段落，页边注释留下后世读者阅读的痕迹。这些中世纪抄写与批注属于文本传播史，并非侯奈因本人的手迹。

items.rationale: Replace generic interpretive framing with a specific attributed manuscript and its later readers; preserve collaborative translation context.

before.en: Physician Li Shizhen completes Compendium of Materia Medica in Qizhou after twenty-seven years of work
before.zh: 李时珍历二十七载三易其稿，于蕲州撰成药物学巨著《本草纲目》

after.en:
Physician Li Shizhen completes Compendium of Materia Medica in Qizhou after twenty-seven years of work

Plant illustrations preserved in an 1883 edition show the book’s later visual life. Four labelled panels compare leaves, flowers, bulbs and roots. Wellcome identifies these as pages from a later edition, distinct from the work’s first publication in 1596 and from Li Shizhen’s earlier manuscript.
after.zh:
李时珍历二十七载三易其稿，于蕲州撰成药物学巨著《本草纲目》

1883年版本保存的植物插图，展示这部著作后来的图像面貌。四个标注名称的图栏并置叶、花、鳞茎与根。惠康将其明确标为后世版本，不能与1596年首刊本或李时珍此前完成的原稿混为一谈。

items.rationale: Show a specific later textual witness, keeping it distinct from the original author’s manuscript and period.

before.en:
Ulugh Beg combined Timurid political authority with sustained interest in mathematical astronomy. The observatory associated with his court in Samarkand relied on several scholars, instruments, observations and calculations. Naming one ruler should not hide the work of colleagues such as al-Kashi and Qadi Zada or the institutional resources that made the project possible.

A star catalogue and astronomical tables were tools for subsequent calculation and comparison, not simply monuments to personal prestige. The conventional 1437 catalogue date supplies a useful anchor, while particular revisions and later circulation require more detailed textual study. Reading the biography with the existing observatory entry connects an individual with a place without duplicating its site history. His violent political end also warns against assuming that scholarly achievement guaranteed stable dynastic rule.
before.zh:
兀鲁伯把帖木儿政治权威与对数学天文的持续兴趣结合起来。撒马尔罕宫廷相关的天文台依赖多位学者、仪器、观测和计算。以一位统治者命名，不应遮蔽卡西、卡迪扎德等同事的工作，以及使计划成为可能的制度资源。

星表和天文表是后来计算、比较的工具，不只是个人声望的纪念物。惯用的1437年星表日期提供锚点，但具体修订与后续传播需要更细的文本研究。与已有天文台条目并读，可连接人物与地点而不重复遗址史。其暴力性的政治结局也提醒我们，学术成就不能保证王朝稳定。

after.en:
Ulugh Beg combined Timurid political authority with an interest in mathematical astronomy. His court’s observatory in Samarkand brought together scholars including al-Kashi and Qadi Zada, instruments and repeated calculations. Its star catalogue and astronomical tables supported later observation and comparison.

John Greaves published Epochae celebriores in London in 1650, drawing on chronology transmitted under Ulugh Beg’s name. The Persian-and-Latin edition names Greaves as editor and commentator: a surviving stage in the work’s passage from a Timurid scholarly setting to European readers.
after.zh:

约翰·格里夫斯1650年在伦敦刊行《著名纪元》，依据以兀鲁伯之名传承的年代学材料。波斯文与拉丁文版本列明格里夫斯的编辑与注释角色，保存了知识从帖木儿学术环境进入欧洲读者世界的一个环节。

before.en: Ibn Battuta left Tangier on pilgrimage in 1325 and continued travelling for many years through Africa and Asia. Legal training and shared religious institutions helped him find hospitality and employment, including service in Delhi. His experiences expose networks of scholars, merchants, pilgrims, rulers, and enslaved people rather than an empty world waiting to be discovered. After returning to Morocco, he related his travels to Ibn Juzayy, who shaped them into the Rihla. That collaboration matters: this is a retrospective literary narrative, and parts of its itinerary are disputed. It remains a rich starting point for asking what travellers observed, what they misunderstood, and how their expectations influenced the worlds they described.
before.zh: 伊本·白图泰于1325年离开丹吉尔朝觐，此后多年游历非洲与亚洲。法律知识和共同的宗教制度帮助他获得接待与工作，包括在德里任职。他的经历展示学者、商人、朝觐者、统治者与被奴役者的网络，而不是等待被“发现”的空白世界。回到摩洛哥后，他向伊本·朱扎伊口述经历，由后者整理成《游记》。这种合作十分重要：文本是回顾性的文学叙事，部分行程存在争议。它仍是思考旅行者看见了什么、误解了什么，以及期待如何影响描述的重要起点。

after.en:

Legal training and religious institutions helped him find hospitality and employment, including service in Delhi. His travels passed through networks of scholars, merchants, pilgrims, rulers and enslaved people. Back in Morocco, he related his experiences to Ibn Juzayy, who shaped them into the Rihla. The resulting account is retrospective and literary; parts of its itinerary are disputed.

Samuel Lee’s 1829 English title page identifies abridged Arabic manuscripts at Cambridge as the basis of his translation. The catalogue attributes the abridgment to Muhammad ibn Fath Allah al-Bayluni. The page makes an editorial chain visible: oral recollection, compilation, abridgment and translation.

塞缪尔·李1829年英译本的扉页说明，翻译依据剑桥所藏阿拉伯文节本手稿，目录将节本归于穆罕默德·伊本·法特赫·阿拉·拜卢尼。这一页呈现口述、编纂、节编与翻译相继发生的传播过程。

before.en:
Louis Riel became a spokesman for Métis resistance when Canadian expansion threatened Red River’s landholding and political arrangements. He headed a provisional government after the occupation of Upper Fort Garry in 1869. Negotiations helped establish Manitoba in 1870, but the settlement did not prevent conflict, displacement or the failure to secure all promised protections.

Riel’s career also involved the provisional government’s execution of Thomas Scott, exile in the United States and a return to the North-West in 1884. In 1885 he led resistance connected with Métis land grievances and was convicted and executed for treason. Different communities have interpreted his actions differently. His life joins constitutional negotiation to the social history of a people whose institutions existed before Canada’s claim to administer their homeland.
before.zh:
加拿大扩张威胁红河地区的土地与政治安排时，路易·里尔成为梅蒂斯抵抗的发言人。1869年上加里堡被占后，他领导临时政府。协商促成1870年马尼托巴省建立，但没有阻止冲突、迁离或承诺保护未能落实。

他的生涯还涉及临时政府处决托马斯·斯科特、流亡美国，以及1884年返回西北地区。1885年，他领导与梅蒂斯土地不满有关的抵抗，随后以叛国罪被定罪并处决。不同社群对其行动有不同解释。他的一生把宪制协商同梅蒂斯社会史相连：加拿大提出行政主张之前，这个民族已拥有自己的制度。

An 1870 group photograph preserved at Lakehead University places Riel among the provisional government’s councillors. Seated and standing figures share the frame; the archive identifies Riel at the centre.

before.en:
Sei Shōnagon’s Pillow Book gathers observations, lists, anecdotes and judgments from life around the Heian court. Attention to clothing, timing, conversation and poetry reveals how cultivated conduct helped make social distinctions. The writing is neither a continuous political chronicle nor a neutral survey of all Japanese society.

Her position as a court woman shaped what she could observe and whose conduct she judged. The work gives access to an authored perspective on aristocratic life while leaving farmers, laborers and many other people largely outside its frame. Comparing it with Murasaki Shikibu’s fiction exposes different literary ways of representing a related elite world. Uncertain life dates should not be replaced by invented precision; this entry follows the approximate period of the work.
before.zh:
清少纳言的《枕草子》汇集平安宫廷生活中的观察、清单、轶事与评价。对衣着、时机、谈吐和诗歌的关注，显示精致举止如何制造社会区分。它既不是连续的政治编年史，也不是对全体日本社会的中立调查。

宫廷女性的位置影响了她能观察什么、评价何人的行为。作品让读者接近一个关于贵族生活的作者视角，同时把农民、劳动者等许多人留在叙述框架之外。与紫式部小说比较，可看到表现相近精英世界的不同文学方式。其生卒年不应被虚构的精确日期取代，因此本条采用作品的大致时代。

after.en:
Sei Shōnagon’s Pillow Book gathers observations, lists, anecdotes and judgments from the Heian court. Clothing, conversation and poetry reveal how cultivated conduct marked social distinctions within aristocratic life.

A seventeenth-century painting by Tosa Mitsuoki turns one literary exchange into a visible gesture. In the episode identified by the Japanese museum record, the empress asks about the snow on Incense-Burner Peak, alluding to a poem by Bai Juyi; Sei answers by raising a blind. The painted figure belongs to the work’s later reception, not a contemporary portrait of its author.
after.zh:

土佐光起的十七世纪绘画把一次文学问答化为可见动作。日文馆藏记录所指的段落中，中宫以白居易诗句问及“香炉峰之雪”，清少纳言便卷起帘子作答。画中形象属于著作的后世接受史，并非作者生前的肖像。

before.en:
Gaya comprised several polities in the southern peninsula rather than a single centralized kingdom. Their cemeteries shared forms of stone-lined chambers and pottery while retaining local differences. The combination allows archaeologists to investigate both connections and political autonomy. Burial similarities alone do not demonstrate one government.

Pottery and other specialized products circulated through regional relationships. Elite cemeteries occupied prominent positions near local centers, making authority visible in the landscape. Silla’s expansion brought the independent Gaya polities under its control by the middle of the sixth century. A confederated political history therefore sits beside the histories of larger kingdoms and challenges a map that fills all early Korea with only three uniform blocks.
before.zh:
伽耶由半岛南部的多个政体构成，并非单一中央集权王国。各地墓园共享石室结构与陶器形式，同时保留地方差异。考古学因此能够同时研究彼此联系和政治自主；葬俗相似本身不能证明存在统一政府。

陶器等专业产品通过区域关系流通。精英墓园常位于地方中心附近的显著位置，使权威在景观中可见。至六世纪中叶，新罗扩张逐渐结束了各伽耶政体的独立地位。这样的联盟型政治史应与较大王国并列，提醒我们不能只用三个整齐色块表现早期半岛历史。

A fifth-century long-necked jar in the Metropolitan Museum (1997.34.4) is attributed specifically to Great Gaya. Raised bands and textured strips divide its tall neck above a rounded body.

before.en:
A small scorpion-like mark on a cloth's hem can preserve authorship even when a name has been lost. Two hand-painted àdìrẹ cloths collected in Ibadan in the 1960s carry such a signature. Women painted cassava-starch resist onto cotton before indigo dyeing, leaving pale designs when the protected areas were revealed. Other makers tied or stitched the cloth to resist the dye.

Patterns responded to the city and to customers. One celebrated Ibadan through the columns of Mapo Hall; another design was described to collectors as the fashionable cloth of 1964. Imported factory cotton became a material for local invention. These textiles connect Nigeria's political milestones to working knowledge, changing taste and women's businesses. The signature invites recognition of a maker without supplying a name that the collection cannot establish.
before.zh:
衣边一个像蝎子的标记，即使姓名失传，也可能保存作者身份。二十世纪六十年代在伊巴丹购藏的两件手绘阿迪雷布，带有这样的署名。女子在棉布上涂木薯淀粉防染，再浸入靛蓝，受到保护的部分形成浅色纹样。其他制作者则通过扎结或缝缀防染。

图案回应城市生活与顾客需求。一种用马波市政厅的柱子歌咏伊巴丹；另一种被当地卖家称为1964年的流行布样。进口机制棉布成为本地创新的材料。这些织物把尼日利亚的政治节点与实作知识、品味变化及女子经营联系起来。署名让人看到制作者，却不能补出馆藏尚未确定的姓名。

Patterns responded to the city and to customers. One celebrated Ibadan through the columns of Mapo Hall; another design was described to collectors as the fashionable cloth of 1964. Imported factory cotton became a material for local invention. These textiles connect Nigeria's political milestones to working knowledge, changing taste and women's businesses. The signature invites recognition of a maker without supplying a name that the collection cannot establish.

A separate wrapper at Princeton, dated around 1960, offers another example of the Ibadan design. Its patterned squares include Mapo Hall, while its border bears two maker marks. The museum leaves open whether two women painted it. Comparing the cloths brings individual signatures and variations within a shared design into view.

before.en:
Over the second to fourth centuries, Jewish and Christian communities developed institutions and identities in different settings. Markus Tiwald’s essay argues that differentiation was prolonged and uneven, and reads later writers as evidence that some relationships and contested practices continued. That is a scholarly interpretation of selected texts, not proof of one timetable applying everywhere.

The Metropolitan Museum discusses a third-century synagogue at Dura-Europos near a Christian meeting house. These buildings are material evidence for particular communities, not proof that every Jew and Christian shared the same relationships. Judaism and Christianity both continued to develop after the end of this editorial window.
before.zh:
公元二至四世纪，犹太与基督徒社群在不同环境中发展制度和身份。马库斯·蒂瓦尔德的文章认为，二者分化漫长且各地不一，并把后世作者的文字视为某些关系和有争议实践仍然存在的证据。这是对部分文本的学术解释，不证明各地都遵循同一时间表。

大都会艺术博物馆讨论了杜拉欧罗普斯一座公元三世纪会堂及其附近的基督徒聚会场所。这些建筑是特定社群的物质证据，不证明每个犹太人与基督徒之间的关系都相同。犹太教与基督教在本编辑时段之后均继续发展。

The Metropolitan Museum discusses a third-century synagogue at Dura-Europos near a Christian meeting house.

A Roman gold-glass bowl dated 300–350 preserves a different kind of evidence: an open Torah ark and ritual implements rendered in gold leaf. The Metropolitan Museum identifies menorahs, a shofar and a citron. The fragile fragments make Jewish imagery visible within Roman material culture, alongside the architectural evidence from Dura-Europos.

一件公元300至350年的罗马金箔玻璃碗，保存了另一类证据：以金箔描出的敞开经柜与仪式器物。大都会博物馆识别出烛台、羊角号和香橼。脆弱残片让罗马物质文化中的犹太图像变得可见，与杜拉欧罗普斯的建筑证据相互参照。

before.en:
Wollstonecraft argued that women’s apparent dependence should be examined through education, social expectations and material relationships. Her political writing belonged to debates about virtue, commercial society and the French Revolution, not only to a later history of voting rights. Criticism of inherited privilege and the condition of women formed connected parts of her thought.

A Vindication of the Rights of Woman appeared in 1792. It challenged forms of education that cultivated display and dependence rather than reason and responsibility. The work’s later reception changed: private-life controversy affected her reputation, while readers in different countries returned to her arguments for their own purposes. Her biography connects authorship and intellectual labor with questions about family, livelihood and citizenship. It does not assume that an eighteenth-century writer anticipated every position later associated with feminism, or that publication itself produced equal rights for her contemporaries.
before.zh:
沃斯通克拉夫特主张，应通过教育、社会期待和物质关系来考察女性表现出的依附状态。她的政治写作属于关于德性、商业社会及法国革命的争论，而不只是后来投票权历史的一部分。批评世袭特权与分析女性处境，是其思想中相互联系的内容。

《女权辩护》于1792年出版，挑战培养装饰性表现与依附、却不培养理性和责任的教育方式。作品的接受后来发生变化：私生活争议影响声誉，不同国家的读者又为各自目的重读其论证。她的传记把写作及知识劳动，与家庭、生计和公民身份联系起来。本条不假定十八世纪作者已经预见后来所有女性主义立场，也不把出版等同于同时代女性立即取得平等权利。

before.en:
Al-Biruni worked on astronomy, mathematics, chronology and the comparison of religious and intellectual traditions. His life crossed changes of political patronage in Khwarazm and the Ghaznavid world. Observations and dated statements in his own works provide anchors that are more secure than some reconstructions of his movements.

His account of Indian knowledge involved language learning, comparison and efforts to understand systems different from his own. Such work should not be reduced either to an isolated genius or to a claim that every description was impartial. Scholars can identify both methods and the limits of available evidence. Linking this biography with Aryabhata and Ibn Sina situates intellectual exchange across regions, while the representative pin does not imply a permanent residence or a continuous, independently surveyed route.
before.zh:
比鲁尼研究天文、数学、编年，并比较宗教和思想传统。生涯跨越花剌子模与伽色尼世界中政治资助者的变化。其本人著作中的观测和纪年，为生平提供比某些迁移重建更稳固的锚点。

对印度知识的叙述涉及语言学习、比较以及理解不同体系的努力。这些工作不能缩为孤立天才的故事，也不表示每项描述都不带立场。研究者可以同时辨析方法与现有证据局限。与阿耶波多、伊本·西那相连，可以把思想交换置于跨区域环境；代表性点位不表示永久居所或连续、独立测绘的路线。

after.en:
Al-Biruni worked on astronomy, mathematics, chronology and the comparison of religious and intellectual traditions. His life crossed changes of political patronage in Khwarazm and the Ghaznavid world. His account of Indian knowledge drew on language learning and comparison across intellectual traditions.

A later manuscript at Princeton preserves Ibn Sina’s letter addressed to al-Biruni. Its catalogue identifies two sequences of ten and seven philosophical questions and answers. Copied in a manuscript dated 1279, the opening page makes their scholarly exchange visible as a text transmitted between generations.
after.zh:
比鲁尼研究天文、数学、编年，并比较宗教与思想传统。其生涯跨越花剌子模与伽色尼世界中政治资助者的变化；对印度知识的叙述则依靠语言学习与不同思想传统之间的比较。

普林斯顿保存的一部后世手稿收录伊本·西那致比鲁尼的书信。目录指出其中有两组哲学问答，分别包含十问与七问。目录定年为1279年的手稿开篇，让这场学术交流以历代传抄的文本形式呈现在眼前。

before.en:
The Sulalat al-Salatin, commonly known as the Malay Annals, assembled stories of kings and political ancestry connected with Melaka and its successors. Work associated with the Johor court in 1612 took place amid repeated attacks and relocation. A prestigious past could provide a language for claiming authority when control of the present was insecure.

The text exists in multiple versions, and attribution to Tun Sri Lanang involves questions of compiling and editing earlier material. It should not be treated as a modern single-author chronicle whose every episode has the same evidential status. Stories, genealogy and political memory require comparison with other sources. Reading the work as a courtly intervention preserves its historical value without converting legitimizing legend into a literal map of early states.
before.zh:
通常称为《马来纪年》的《诸王世系》，汇集同马六甲及其继承者有关的君王和政治祖系故事。1612年同柔佛宫廷相关的编纂，发生于反复进攻和迁移之中；在现实控制不稳时，显赫过去可为权威诉求提供语言。

文本存有多个版本，敦斯里拉囊的归属还涉及对早期资料的汇编与编辑，不能视为现代单一作者的编年史，并把每个情节赋予同样证据地位。故事、谱系与政治记忆需要同其他资料比较。将作品理解为宫廷干预，可保留历史价值，又不把合法化传说变成早期国家的字面地图。

after.en:
The Malay Annals joins royal genealogy with stories of Melaka and its successors. Tun Sri Lanang is associated with Johor’s 1612 compilation, in a court repeatedly displaced by conflict. Multiple versions preserve a layered work shaped by earlier writings and later editors.

The surviving 1821 London title page opens John Leyden’s English translation, introduced by Stamford Raffles. Its named translator, publisher and date show another stage of transmission, far removed from the seventeenth-century court.
after.zh:
《马来纪年》将王室谱系与马六甲及其继承者的故事相连。敦斯里拉囊同柔佛1612年的编纂相关，当时宫廷因战争反复迁移。存世多个版本叠合了早期书写与后世编辑。

1821年伦敦版扉页开启约翰·莱登的英译本，斯坦福·莱佛士作序。其译者、出版者与日期呈现了远离17世纪宫廷的又一传播阶段。

before.en:
Tun Sri Lanang served as Johor’s bendahara, a senior court office, during struggles with Aceh and Portuguese Melaka. He is associated with the compilation of the Malay Annals, although multiple textual versions make simple claims of sole authorship uncertain. His political position and literary activity belonged to the same courtly world.

A commission in 1612 was followed by Aceh’s attack and his capture in 1613. Accounts connect later work on the text with those circumstances. The narrative of royal descent could help sustain Johor’s claim to Melaka’s inheritance amid displacement. NLB’s discussion also questions older assumptions about his later life. This biography consequently follows a documented activity window rather than assigning unverified birth and death dates or treating a court text as a complete personal autobiography.
before.zh:
敦斯里拉囊在柔佛同亚齐及葡属马六甲竞争期间担任高级宫廷官职“班达哈拉”。他同《马来纪年》的编纂相关，但多个文本版本使“唯一作者”的简单判断存在不确定性。政治职位与文学活动属于同一个宫廷世界。

1612年的编纂委托之后，亚齐于1613年进攻，他被俘获；有关记载把后续写作与这些处境相连。王室血统叙事可以在迁徙中维持柔佛继承马六甲的诉求。新加坡国家图书馆的讨论也质疑了对其晚年的旧假设。因此本传采用有文献支持的活动窗口，不给出未经核实的生卒年，也不把宫廷文本视为个人完整自传。

after.en:
Tun Sri Lanang served as Johor’s bendahara, a senior court official. A 1612 commission to compile the Malay Annals was followed by the Acehnese attack and his capture in 1613. His association with the work includes the compilation and editing of earlier material.

The 1821 English edition shown here is a later translation, not a surviving page in his hand. Read its title page alongside the court story to distinguish compilation, translation and publication as separate moments.
after.zh:
敦斯里拉囊任柔佛高级宫廷官职班达哈拉。1612年受命编纂《马来纪年》后，1613年亚齐进攻，他遭到俘获。他同作品的关系也涉及对早期资料的汇编和编辑。

这里展示的是1821年英译本，并非他的亲笔遗页。将扉页与宫廷故事并读，可分辨编纂、翻译与出版这几个不同阶段。

before.en:
Nguyễn Du lived through the collapse of an older political order, Tây Sơn upheaval and the establishment of the Nguyễn dynasty. His movement between elite family settings, periods of insecurity and official service gave his writing a context shaped by political change. Entering Nguyễn service in 1802 did not erase those earlier experiences.

The Tale of Kiều used Vietnamese literary expression in a character-based writing tradition and became a work repeatedly copied, printed and interpreted. Its story of a woman’s constrained choices should not be mistaken for a transparent transcript of one historical life. Manuscripts and printed objects preserve the work’s transmission as well as its words. His biography therefore links court service, language and literary memory without assigning one undisputed composition year to the poem.
before.zh:
阮攸经历旧政治秩序瓦解、西山动荡与阮朝建立。他在精英家族环境、不安定生活及官职之间的转移，为写作提供了政治变化塑造的语境。1802年进入阮朝仕途，并未抹去此前经历。

《金云翘传》以字喃等字符传统表达越南语，后来不断被抄写、刊印和解释。作品描绘女性受约束的选择，但不能把文学故事当作某个历史人物生平的直接记录。抄本与印本既保存文字，也保存传播过程。因此，传记把仕途、语言与文学记忆相连，不为长诗强加一个毫无争议的写成年份。

after.en:
Nguyễn Du lived through Tây Sơn upheaval and the establishment of the Nguyễn dynasty, entering Nguyễn service in 1802. His Tale of Kiều became a major work of Vietnamese literature, continually copied, printed and interpreted.

A British Library manuscript from the second half of the nineteenth century pairs the story with illustrations. Its opening places three figures below the title; handwritten annotations and a library stamp record later encounters with the book. This is a copy made after the poet’s death, not his autograph.
after.zh:
阮攸经历西山动荡与阮朝建立，于1802年进入阮朝仕途。《金云翘传》成为越南文学重要作品，不断被抄写、刊印与诠释。

大英图书馆收藏的一部19世纪后半叶抄本，将故事与插图结合。卷首题名下绘有三个人物，手写批注与馆藏印章记录了书籍后来的流转。这是诗人去世后的抄本，而非亲笔原稿。
